name: Abies Canadensis
author: Boericke
intro: Mucous membranes are affected by Abies-c. Gastric symptoms are most marked, a catarrhal condition of the stomach is produced. There are peculiar cravings with chilly sensations that are characteristic, especially in women with uterine displacements, probably due to defective nutrition and debility. Respiration and action of the heart, laboured. Wants to lie down all the time; skin cold and clammy, hands cold; very faint. Right lung and liver feel small and hard. Gleet.

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Feels light headed, tipsy. lritable.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Canine hunger with a torpid liver. Gnawing, hungry, faint feeling in the epigastrium. Great appetite, craving for meat, pickles, radishes, turnips, antichokes, coarse food. Tendency to eat far beyond the capacity for digestion (bulimia). Burning and distention of the stomach and abdomen with palpitations (indigestion). Gastritis. Flatulence, dis- turbing the heart's action. Pain in right shoulder blade and constipation, with buming in the rectum.

sections.title: Female
sections.content: Uterine displacements. Sore feeling in the fundus of the uterus, relieved by pressure. Prostration; wants to lie down all the time. Feels womb is soft and feeble. '

sections.title: Fever
sections.content: Shivering and chills all over, as if blood was tumed into ice water (Acon.). Chills run down the back. Sensation of cold water, between the shoulders (Am-m.}. Skin clammy and sticky. Night sweats (Chin.).

sections.title: Dose
sections.content: First to third potency.

name: Abies Nigra
author: Boericke
modalities: Worse after eating.
relationships: Compare: (Lump in stomach—Chin.; Bry.; Puls.) also other Conifers—Thuj.; Sabin.; Cupressus lawsoniana (painful indigestion) also Nux-v., Kali-c.
intro:
A powerful and long acting remedy for various diseases, whenever the characteristic stomach symptoms are present. Most of the symptoms are associated with gastric disturbances. In dyspeptic problems of the aged, with functional heart symptoms; also after tea or tobacco. Constipation. Pain in the external meatus.

Feels womb is soft and feeble, as if it would cause an abortion (Clarke - Dictionary of Practical Materia Medica). A2 Abies nigra @ Abrus precatorius

Head — Hot, with flushed cheeks. Low spirited. Dull during the day, awake at night. Unable to think.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Pain in stomach, always comes on after eating. Sensa- tion of a painful lump, as if a hard boiled egg was lodged in the cardiac end of the stomach; continuous, distressing constriction just above the pit of the stomach, as if everything was knotted up. Total loss of appetite in the moming, but a great craving for food at noon and night. Offensive breath (halitosis). Eractations, dyspepsia.

sections.title: Respiratory
sections.content: Painful sensation, as if something was lodged in the chest, has to be coughed up; lungs feel compressed. Cannot be fully expanded. Worse coughing; waterbrash succeeds cough. Choking sensa- tion in the throat. Dyspnea worse lying down (orthopnea).

sections.title: Heart
sections.content: Sharp cutting pain the region of heart. Heart's action is laboured and slow; tachycardia, bradycardia.

sections.title: Back
sections.content: Pain in the small of back.' Rheumatic pains and aching in bones.

sections.title: Sleep
sections.content: Wakeful and restless at night, with hunger. Bad dreams.

sections.title: Fever
sections.content: Alternate heat and cold; chronic intermittent fever, with pain in the stomach.

sections.title: Modalities
sections.content: Worse after eating.

sections.title: Relationship
sections.content: Compare: (Lump in stomach—Chin.; Bry.; Puls.) also other Conifers—Thuj.; Sabin.; Cupressus lawsoniana (painful indigestion) also Nux-v., Kali-c.

sections.title: Dose
sections.content: First to thirtieth potency.

author: Boericke
modalities: Worse, cold air, checked secretions. Better, motion. lespecially in new borns (Clarke — Dictionary of Practical Materia Medica). A4 Absinthium
relationships: Compare: Scrophularia; Bry.; Stel.; Benz-ac., in gout. lod.; Nat-m. in marasmus.
intro: A very useful remedy in marasmus, especially of the lower extrem- ities, despite a good appetite. Metastasis. Rheumatism, following checked diarthea. Ill effects of suppressed conditions especially in gouty subjects. Tuberculous peritonitis. Exudative pleurisy and other exudative pro- cesses. After surgery, for hydrothorax or empyema, a pressing sensation remains. Aggravation of haemorrhoids when rheumatism improves. Epistaxis and hydrocele in boys. Great weakness after influenza (Kali-p.).

sections.title: Mind
sections.content: Cross, iritable, anxious, depressed.

sections.title: Face
sections.content: Wrinkled, cold, dry, pale. Blue rings around dull looking eyes. Comedones, with emaciation. Epistaxis. Angioma of the face.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Slimy taste. Appetite good, but emaciation progresses. Food passes undigested (lienteria). Pain in the stomach; worse at night; cutting,gnawing pain. Stomach feels as if swimming in water; feels cold. Gnawing hunger and whining. Indigestion, with vomiting of large quan- tities of offensive fluid.

sections.title: Abdomen
sections.content: Hard lumps in different parts of the abdomen. Dis- tended. Alternate diarrhea and constipation. Haemorrhoids. Frequent urging; bloody stools; worse as rheumatic pains abate. Ascarides. Oozing of blood and moisture from the umbilicus’. Sensation as if bowels were sinking.

sections.title: Respiratory
sections.content: Raw feeling. Impeded respiration. Dry cough follow- ing diarrhea. Pain across the chest; severe in the region of heart.

sections.title: Back
sections.content: Neck very weak, cannot hold head up. Back lame, weak, and painful. Pain in lumbar region extending along the spermatic cord. Pain in the sacrum, with haemorthoids.

sections.title: Extremities
sections.content: Pain in the shoulders, arms, wrists and            ankles. Pricking and coldness in fingers and feet (chilblains). Legs greatly emaciated. Joints stiff and lame. Painful contraction of limbs (Am-m.).

sections.title: Skin
sections.content: Eruptions on the face are suppressed, and the skin becomes purplish. Skin flabby and loose. Furuncles. Falling out of hair. Itching chilblains. .

sections.title: Modalities
sections.content: Worse, cold air, checked secretions. Better, motion. lespecially in new borns (Clarke — Dictionary of Practical Materia Medica). A4 Absinthium

sections.title: Relationship
sections.content: Compare: Scrophularia; Bry.; Stel.; Benz-ac., in gout. lod.; Nat-m. in marasmus.

sections.title: Dose
sections.content: Third to thirtieth potency.

intro: A perfect picture an epileptiform seizures is produced by this drug. Nervous tremors precede attack. Sudden and severe giddiness, delinum with hallucinations and loss of consciousness. Nervous excitement and sleeplessness. Cerebral irritation,’ hysterical and infantile spasms come within the range of this remedy. Poisoning by mushrooms. Chorea. Tremors. Nervousness, excitement, and sleeplessness in children.

sections.title: Mind

sections.title: Face

name: Acalypha Indica
author: Boericke
modalities: Worse in the moming.
relationships: Compare: Mill.; Phos.; Acet-ac.; Kali-n.
intro: A drug having a marked action on the alimentary canal and respi- Tatory organs. It is indicated in incipient phthisis, with hard, racking cough, bloody expectoration, arterial haemorrhage, but no febrile distur- bance. Very weak in the moming, gains strength during the day. Progressive emaciation. All pathological haemorrhages having a morning aggravation.

sections.title: Abdomen
sections.content: Buming in the intestines. Spluttering diarrhea with forcible expulsion of noisy flatus, bearing down pains and tenesmus. Rumbling distention, and gripping pain in the abdomen. Rectal haemorrhage; worse in the moming.

sections.title: Respiratory
sections.content: Cough dry, hard, followed by haemoptysis; worse in the moming and at night. Constant and severe pain in the chest. Blood bright red and profuse in the moming; dark and clotted in the afternoon. Pulse, soft and compressible. Buming in the pharynx, oesophagus, and stomach.

sections.title: Skin
sections.content: Jaundiced.    Itching and circumscribed furuncle like swell- ings.

sections.title: Modalities
sections.content: Worse in the moming.

sections.title: Relationship
sections.content: Compare: Mill.; Phos.; Acet-ac.; Kali-n.

sections.title: Dose
sections.content: Third to sixth potency.

intro:
(Glacial Acetic Acid) Acet-ac.

This drug produces a condition of profound anaemia, with dropsy, great debility, frequent fainting, dyspnea, weak heart, vomiting, profuse micturition and sweat. Haemorrhage from any part. Especially indicated in pale, lean people, with lax, flabby muscles. Wasting and debility. Acet- ac. has the power to liquify albuminous and fibrinous deposits. Epithelial cancer, internally and locally (W. Owens). Sycosis with nodular forma- tions in the joints.! Hard chancre. The 1x solution will soften and cause formation of pus.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Salivation. Fermentation in the stomach. Intense buming thirst. Cold drinks distress. Vomits after every kind of food. Epigastric tendemess. Burning pain, as of an ulcer. Cancer of stomach. Sour belching and vomiting. Buming waterbrash and profuse salivation. Hyperchlorhydria and gastralgia. Violent burning pains in the stomach and chest, followed by coldness of the skin and cold sweat on the forehead. Stomach feels as if consumed a lot of vinegar. Abdomen — Feels as if, the abdomen was sinking. Frequent watery stools, worse in the moming. Tympanitic. Ascites. Haemorrhage from bowels. Urinary — Large quantities of pale urine. Anaemia is nursing mothers.

sections.title: Back

sections.title: Extremities

sections.title: Fever

Thinks his thoughts come from the stomach that parts of his body are abnormally thick. Feels as if what had just been done was a dream.

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Fullness; heavy, pulsating, hot, bursting, buming, undulat- ing sensation (apolexy). Intracranial pressure (Hed). Buming headache, sensation as if brain was agitated by boiling water.' Heat and ebullition in the head, as if there was boiling water in the brain (Indg.). Vertigo; worse on rising (Nux-v., Op.) and on shaking the head. Sensation as if hair were being pulled or were standing on end especially on the vertex. Nocturnal, furious delirium.

sections.title: Eyes
sections.content: Red, inflamed. (acute conjunctivitis). Feels dry and hot, as if sand in them (trachoma). Lids swollen, hard and red (blepharitis). Aversion to light (photophobia). Profuse watering after exposure to dry, cold winds, reflection from snow, after extraction of cinders and other foreign bodies.

sections.title: Ears
sections.content: Very sensitive to noises; music is unbearable. Extemal ear hot, red, painful, swollen. Otalgia (Cham.). Sensation as if a drop of water is in the left ear.

sections.title: Nose
sections.content: Smell, acutely sensitive. Pain at the root of the nose. Coryza; much sneezing; throbbing in the nostrils. Haemorrhage of bright red blood. Mucous membrane dry, nose stopped up; dry or with scanty watery coryza.

sections.title: Face
sections.content: Red, hot, flushed, swollen (mumps). One cheek red, the 'Heat and ebullition in the head, as if there was boiling water in the brain. (Clarke — Dictionary of Practical Materia Medica). Aconitum napellus } 9A other pale (Cham., Ip.). On rising, the red face becomes deathly pale, or he becomes dizzy. Tingling in cheeks with numbness. Neuralgia, especially of the left side, with restlessness, tingling, and numbness (trigeminal neuralgia). Pain in jaws.

sections.title: Mouth
sections.content: Numb, dry, and tingling. Tongue swollen; tip tingles. (glossitis). Teeth sensitive to cold. Constantly moves the lower jaw, as if chewing. Gums hot and inflamed (gingivitis). Tongue coated white (Ant- ¢.).

sections.title: Throat
sections.content: Red, dry, constricted, numb, prickling, buming, stinging. Tonsils swollen and dry (1st stage of tonsillitis).

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Vomiting, with fear, heat, profuse sweat and increased micturition. Thirst for cold water. Bitter taste of everything except water. Intense thirst. Drinks, vomits, and declares that he will die. Vomiting, bilious, mucoid, bloody and greenish. Pressure in the stomach with dyspnea. Haematemesis. Buming from the stomach to the oesophagus.

sections.title: Abdomen
sections.content: Hot, tense, tympanitic (enteritis). Sensitive to touch. Colic, no position relieves. Abdominal symptoms better after warm soup. Buming in the umbilical region.

sections.title: Rectum
sections.content: Pain with nocturnal itching and stitching pains in the anus. Frequent, small stool with tenesmus; green, like chopped herbs. White with red urine. Choleric discharge with collapse, anxiety, and restlessness. Bleeding haemorthoids (Ham.). Watery diarrhea in children (cholera infantum). They cry and complain a lot, are sleepless and rest- less.

sections.title: Urinary
sections.content: Scanty, red, hot, painful. Tenesmus and buming at the neck of the bladder. Buming in the urethra. Unne suppressed, bloody (haematuria). Anxiety always when beginning to micturate. Retention, with screaming and restlessness. Handling of genitals. Renal region sensitive (nephritis). Profuse micturition, with profuse perspiration and diarrhea.

sections.title: Male
sections.content: Crawling and stinging in glans. Bruised pain in the testicles, swollen and hard (orchitis). Frequent erections and emissions. Painful erections.

sections.title: Female
sections.content: Vagifia dry, hot, sensitive. Menses too profuse, with epistaxis, too protracted, late. Frenzy on appearance of menses. Sup- pressed from fright, cold, in plethoric subjects. Ovaries congested and painful. Sharp shooting pain in the womb. After-pains, with fear and restlessness. H.M. M.-4 A 10 Aconitum napellus Respiratory — Constant pressure in the left chest; oppressed breathing on least motion (asthma). Hoarse, dry, croupy cough (bronchi- tis); loud, laboured breathing (pneumonia). Child grasps the throat every time he coughs (whooping cough). Very sensitive to inspired air. Short- ness of breath. Larynx sensitive. Stitches through the chest (pleurisy, pleurodynia). Cough, dry, short, hacking; worse at night and after midnight. Hot feeling in the lungs. Blood comes up with hawking (haemoptysis, phthisis). Tingling in the chest after cough. Heart — Tachycardia. Affections of the heart with pain in the left shoulder. Stitching pain in the chest (angina pectoris). Palpitations, with anxiety, fainting, and tingling in fingers. Pulse full, hard; tense and bounding; sometimes intermits. Temporal and carotid arteries felt when sitting. Back — Numb, stiff, painful. Crawling and tingling, as if bruised. Stiffness in the nape of neck. Bruised pain between scapulae. Extremities — Numbness and tingling; shooting pains; icy coldness and insensibility of hands and feet. Arms feel lame, bruised, heavy, numb. Pain down the left arm (Cact.; Crot-h.; Kalm.; Tab.). Hot hands and cold feet. Rheumatic inflammation of joints; worse at night; red shiny swelling, very sensitive. Hip joint and thigh feel lame, especially after lying down. Knees unsteady; disposition of the foot to tum (Aesc.). Weak and lax ligaments of all joints. Painless cracking of all joints. Bright red hypoth- enar eminences on both hands. Sensation as if drops of water trickled down the thigh.

sections.title: Sleep
sections.content: Nightmares. Noctumal ravings. Anxious dreams. Sleep- lessness, with restlessness and tossing about (Use thirtieth potency.). Starts in sleep. Long dreams, with anxiety in the chest. Insomnia in the aged.

sections.title: Fever
sections.content: Cold stage is most marked. Cold sweat and icy coldness of the face. Coldness and heat alternate. Evening chills soon after going to bed. Cold waves pass through the body. Thirst and restlessness always present. Chilly, if uncovered or touched. Dry heat, red face. Most valuable febrifuge with mental anxiety, restlessness, etc. Sweat drenching, on parts lain on; relieving all symptoms.

sections.title: Skin
sections.content: Red, hot, swollen, dry, buming. Purpura miliaris. Rash like measles. Gooseflesh. Formication and numbness. Chilliness and formi- cation down the back. Pruritus relieved by stimulants.

Ebullition of blood to the head, excited by drinking coffee. Vertigo, tearing headache, better in the open air, throbbing in the brain, pain from the crown to between the eyebrows; heat in the forehead, pain in the left frontal eminence as if the bone was crushed. Itching of scalp alternating with heat. Red tip of nose, fluent coryza. ! Face — Violent pain in the upper jaw, from the teeth through the malar bones to the temples. Perspiration on face and head. Stomach — Tearing, darting pains in the epigastric region, with vomiting (cancer of stomach). Cramp like pains in the stomach and epigastrium, with difficult breathing;' sense of suffocation. name: Adonis Vernalis
author: Boericke
relationships: Adonidinum is a cardiac tonic and diuretic. Quarter grain daily, or two to five grains of first decimal trituration. increases arterial pressure and prolongs the diastole, favoring emptying of en- gorged veins. It is an excellent substitute for Dig. and is not cumulative in action. Compare: Dig.; Crat.; Conv.; Stroph-h.
dose: Five to ten drops of the tincture. . ADRENALINUM (An Internal Secretion of Suprarenal Glands) Adren. Adrenalin or Epinephrin, the active principle of the medulla of the A 14 Adrenalinum suprarenal gland, (cortical secretion not as yet isolated), is employed as a chemical messenger in the regulation of the activities of the body; in fact, its presence is essential for the activity of the sympathetic nerves. Action of Adren. on any part is the same as the stimulation of sympathetic nerve endings thereto. Local application (1:1,000 solution) on the mucous membranes promptly induces transient ischemia, seen as blanching, persisting several hours after conjunctival instillation. Its action is very prompt, efficient, evanescent, owing to rapid oxidation and is practically harmless, unless repeated too frequently as in atheroma and myocardial heart lesions (in animals it has been reported). Arteries, heart, supra-renal bodies and the vasomotor system are prominently affected. The main action of Adrenalinum is stimulation of the sympathetic nerve endings, notably in the splanchnic area, causing constriction of the peripheral arterioles, resulting in the rise of blood pressure. This is especially observed in the stomach, and intestines; less in the uterus, and skin; nil in the brain and lungs. Furthermore, it slows the pulse, (medul- lary vagus stimulation), and strengthens the heart beat (increased myo- cardial contractility), resembling Dig.; increased glandular activity, glyco- -Suria; depression of the respiratory center; contraction of the muscular tissue is the eye, uterus, vagina; and relaxation of the muscular tissue of the stomach, intestines, and bladder.
intro: A heart medicine, after rheumatism or influenza, or Bright's disease, where the muscles of the heart are in a stage of fatty degeneration, regulates the pulse and increases the power of contractions of the heart, with increased urinary secretions. Most valuable in cardiac dropsy. Low Vitality, with a weak heart and slow, weak pulse. Hydrothorax, ascites. Anasarca. ’ :

sections.content: Feels light; aches across the front, from occiput around the temples to the eyes. Vertigo on rising, tuning the head quickly or on lying down. Tinnitus. Scalp feels tight. Eyes dilated.

sections.title: Mouth
sections.content: Slimy. Tongue dirty yellow, sore, feels scalded.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Heavy weight. Gnawing hunger. Faint feeling in the epigastrium. Better out doors.

sections.title: Urinary
sections.content: Oily pellicle on urine. Scanty, albuminuria.

sections.title: Respiratory
sections.content: Frequent desire to take a long breath. Sensation of weight on chest.

sections.title: Heart
sections.content: Mitral and aortic regurgitation. Chronic aortitis. Fatty heart pericarditis. Rheumatic endocarditis (Kalm.). Praecordial pain, palpita- tions, and dyspnea. Marked venous engorgement. Cardiac asthma (Queb.). Fatty heart. Myocarditis, irregular cardiac action, constriction and vertigo. Pulse rapid, irregular.

sections.title: Extremities
sections.content: Aching in nape. Spine stiff and aching. Oedema.

sections.title: Sleep
sections.content: Restless, with homble dreams.

sections.content: Five to ten drops of the tincture. . ADRENALINUM (An Internal Secretion of Suprarenal Glands) Adren. Adrenalin or Epinephrin, the active principle of the medulla of the A 14 Adrenalinum suprarenal gland, (cortical secretion not as yet isolated), is employed as a chemical messenger in the regulation of the activities of the body; in fact, its presence is essential for the activity of the sympathetic nerves. Action of Adren. on any part is the same as the stimulation of sympathetic nerve endings thereto. Local application (1:1,000 solution) on the mucous membranes promptly induces transient ischemia, seen as blanching, persisting several hours after conjunctival instillation. Its action is very prompt, efficient, evanescent, owing to rapid oxidation and is practically harmless, unless repeated too frequently as in atheroma and myocardial heart lesions (in animals it has been reported). Arteries, heart, supra-renal bodies and the vasomotor system are prominently affected. The main action of Adrenalinum is stimulation of the sympathetic nerve endings, notably in the splanchnic area, causing constriction of the peripheral arterioles, resulting in the rise of blood pressure. This is especially observed in the stomach, and intestines; less in the uterus, and skin; nil in the brain and lungs. Furthermore, it slows the pulse, (medul- lary vagus stimulation), and strengthens the heart beat (increased myo- cardial contractility), resembling Dig.; increased glandular activity, glyco- -Suria; depression of the respiratory center; contraction of the muscular tissue is the eye, uterus, vagina; and relaxation of the muscular tissue of the stomach, intestines, and bladder.

sections.title: Uses
sections.content: Its chief therapeutic use depends on its vaso-constriction action; therefore it is a powerful and prompt astringent and haemostatic; is invaluable in checking capillary haemorrhages from all parts, where local or direct application is feasible; nose, ear, mouth, throat, larynx, stomach, rectum, uterus, bladder. intro: The action of this drug is most marked on the lower bowel, produc- ing engorged haemorrhoidal veins, with characteristic backache, and absence of actual constipation. Severe pain but little bleeding. General venous stasis, varicose veins in purple colour; everything is slowed down, digestion, heart, bowels, etc. Torpor and congestion of the liver and portal system, with constipation. Severe backache rendering the patient unfit for business. Flying pains all over. Fullness in various parts; dry, swollen mucous membranes. Throat with haemorrhoidal conditions.'

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Depressed and irritable. Head dull, confused, aching as from a cold. Pressure on.the forehead, with nausea, followed by stitches in the right hypochondrium. Pain from the occiput to the frontal region, with a bruised sensation of the scalp; worse in the moming. Neuralgic stitches from right to left through the forehead followed by flying pains in the epigastrium. Vertigo when sitting and walking. 'Follicular inflammation of the posterior wall (Handbook of Materia Medica by T-F. Allen). A 16 Aesculus hippocastanum Eyes — Heavy and hot, with lachrymation, with enlarged blood vessels. Eyeballs sore. Nose — Dry; inspired air feels cold, nasal passages sensitive to it. Coryza, sneezing. Pressure at the root of the nose. Membrane over turbinate bones distended and boggy, dependent upon hepatic disorders. Mouth — Scalded feeling. Metallic taste. Salivation. Tongue thickly coated, feels as if scalded. Throat — Hot, dry, raw, stitching pains radiating to the ears when swallowing. Follicular pharyngitis connected with hepatic congestion. Veins of the pharynx distended and tortuous. Throat sensitive to inspired air; feels excoriated and constricted, burns like fire on swallowing, in the aftemoon. Early stages of atrophic pharyngitis in dried up, bilious subjects. Hawking of ropy mucus with a sweetish taste. Laryngitis; cough depending on liver disorders. Stomach — Weight, as of a stone, with gnawing, aching pains; maximum about three hours after meals.

sections.title: Abdomen
sections.content: Tendemess and fullness in the region of the liver. Dull aching in the liver region and epigastrium. Pain in the umbilical region. Jaundice; throbbing in the hypogastrium and pelvis.

sections.title: Rectum
sections.content: Dry, aching. Feels full of small sticks. Anus raw, sore. Severe pain after stool, with prolapse. Haemorrhoids, with sharp shoot- ing pains up the back; blind and bleeding; worse during climacteric. Large, hard, dry stools. Mucous membrane seems swollen and obstructs the passage. Imitation caused by ascarides, aids their expulsion. Burning in the anus with chills up and down the back.

sections.title: Urinary
sections.content: Frequent, scanty, dark, muddy, hot. Pain in kidneys, especially left and ureter.

sections.title: Male
sections.content: Discharge of prostatic fluid during stool (prostatorrhea).

sections.title: Female
sections.content: Constant throbbing behind symphysis pubis. Leucorrhea, with lameness of the back, across the sacro-iliac articulation; dark yel- low, sticky, corroding; worse after menses.

sections.title: Heart
sections.content: Feels constricted. Heart's action full and heavy, can feel pulsations all over. Sensation of heat in the chest; pain around the region of heart in haemorrhoidal subjects.

sections.title: Back
sections.content: Lameness in the neck; aching between the shoulder blades (cervical spondylosis); region of spine feels weak; back and legs give out. Hands and feet swell, and become red after washing, feel full.

sections.title: Extremities
sections.content: Aching and soreness in the limbs, in the left acromion process radiating to the arms; finger tips numb.

sections.title: Fever
sections.content: Chill at 4 p.m. Chills run up and down the back. Fever, 7 p.m. to 12 p.m. Evening fever, skin hot and dry. Sweat profuse and hot with fever.

sections.title: Mind
sections.content: Sings, talks, but does not answer. Loquacity. Aversion to work. Indifference. Fearless. Delirium characterized by singing, shout- ing, and muttering; rhymes and prophesies. More decided intoxication—great mental excitement and incoher- ent talking, immoderate gaity altemmates with melancholy. Perception of relative size of objects is lost, takes long steps and jumps over small objects as if they were trunks of trees, a small hole appears as a frightful chasm, a spoonful of water, an immense lake. Physical strength is increased, can lift heavy loads. Twitching accompanies all symptoms. 3. Third stage—produces a condition of furious or raging delirium, screaming, raving, wants to injure himself, etc. 4. Fourth stage—mental depression, languor, indifference, confu- sion, disinclination to work, etc. We do not get the active cerebral congestion of Belladonna, but a general nervous excitement such as is found in delirium tremens, delirium of fevers, etc. Agaricus muscarius 21A . Desire to cover the head warmly (Sil). Headache with epistaxis or a thick mucoid discharge.

sections.title: Eyes
sections.content: Reading difficult, as type seems move, swim. Vibrating specters. Diplopia (Gels.), dim and flickering. Asthenopia from prolonged strain, spasm of accommodation. Twitching of lids and eyeballs (Cod.). Margins of lids red; itch, bum and agglutinate (blepharitis). Inner canthi very red.

sections.title: Ears
sections.content: Bum and itch, as if frozen (frost bite). Twitching of muscles around the ear and noises (tinnitus).

sections.title: Nose
sections.content: Nervous nasal disturbances. Itching internally and exter- nally. Spasmodic sneezing after coughing; sensitiveness; watery non- inflammatory discharge. Inner angles very red. Fetid, dark, bloody dis- charge. Epistaxis in old people. Sensation of soreness in the nose and mouth.

sections.title: Face
sections.content: Facial muscles feel stiff; twitch; face itches and bums. Lancinating, tearing pain in cheeks, as of splinters. Neuralgia, as if cold needles ran through the nerves or sharp pieces of ice touched them.

sections.title: Mouth
sections.content: Buming and smarting of lips. Herpes labialis . Twitching. Taste sweet. Aphthae at the roof of the mouth. Splinter like pains in the tongue. Thirsty all the time. Tremulous tongue (Lach.). Tongue white.

sections.title: Throat
sections.content: Stitches along the eustachian tube to the ear. Feels contracted. Small solid balls of phlegm thrown up. Dryness of pharynx, dysphagia. Scratching in the throat; cannot sing a note.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Empty eructations, tasting of apples. Nervous distur- bances, with spasmodic contractions, hiccough. Unnatural hunger. Flatu- lent distention of the stomach and abdomen. Profuse inodorous flatus. Buming in the stomach, about three hours after a meal, followed by a dull pressure. Gastric disturbance with sharp pains in the liver region.

sections.title: Abdomen
sections.content: Stitching pains in the liver, spleen (Cean.) and abdo- men. Stitches under the short ribs, left side. Diarrhea with much fetid flatus. Fetid stools.

sections.title: Urinary
sections.content: Stitches in urethra. Sudden and violent urge to micturate. Frequent micturition. A 22 Agaricus uscarius

sections.title: Female

sections.title: Respiratory

sections.title: Heart
sections.content: Irregular, tumultuous palpitations, after tobacco. Pulse inter- mittent and irregular. Cardiac region oppressed, as if the thorax was too narrow. Palpitations with hyperemia of the face.

sections.title: Back
sections.content: Pain, spine sensitive to. touch; worse in the dorsal region. Lumbago; worse in open air. Crick in the back. Twitching of cervical muscles.

sections.title: Extremities

On falling asleep, starts, twitches, and wakes up often. Vivid dreams. Drowsy during the day. Yawning, followed by involuntary laugh- ter.

sections.title: Fever

sections.title: Skin

intro: From its action on the sympathetic nerves, Alfalfa favorably influ- ences nutrition, evidenced by the “toning up” of appetite and digestion, resulting in a greatly improved mental and physical vigor, with gain in weight. Disorders characterized by malnutrition are mainly within its therapeutic range, for example, neurasthenia, splanchnic blues, nervous- ness, insomnia, nervous indicestion, etc. Acts as a fat producer, corrects tissue waste. Deficient lactation. Increases quality and quantity of milk in nursing mothers. Its pronounced urinary action suggests it clinically in diabetes insipidus and phosphaturia; and it is claimed to allay cystitis of prostatic hypertrophy. The rheumatic diathesis seems especially ame- nable to its action.

sections.title: Mind
sections.content: It induces mental exhilaration of buoyancy, i.e., a general feeling of well being; clear and bright, so that all blues are dissipated. Dull, drowsy, stupid (Gels.); gloomy and imitable, worse during evening.

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Dull, heavy feeling in the occiput, in and above the eyes, worse towards evening. Pain on the left side of the head. Violent headache.

sections.title: Ears
sections.content: Stuffed feeling in the eustachian tubes (Kali-m.) at night; patulous in the moming.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Increased thirst. Appetite impaired, but chiefly increased, even to bulimia. Must eat frequently, cannot wait for regular meals; hungry in the forenoon (Sulph.). Much nibbling of food and craving for sweets.

sections.title: Abdomen
sections.content: Flatulence with distention. Shifting, flatulent pain along the colon several hours after meals. Frequent, loose, yellow, painful stools, with excoriating flatulence. Chronic appendicitis.

sections.title: Urinary
sections.content: Kidneys inactive; frequent urging to micturate. Polyuria (Ph-ac.). Increased elimination of urea, indican and phosphates.

sections.title: Sleep
sections.content: Slept better than usual, especially, early moming; it induces a quiet, reposeful and refreshing sleep.

intro: A picture of coryza, with acrid nasal discharge and laryngeal symp- toms, eye secretions bland; singers cold, worse in a warm room and - towards evening; better in open air. Specially adapted to phlegmatic patients; colds in damp, cold weather. Neuralgic pains, like a fine thread, following amputations or injuries to nerves. Traumatic, chronic neuritis. Buming in the nose, mouth, throat, bladder and skin. Sensation of glowing heat on different parts of the body.

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Catarrhal headache, mostly in the forehead; worse in a warm room, towards evening. Thread like pains in the face. Headache ceases during menses; returns when flow disappears.

sections.title: Eyes
sections.content: Red.      Intense burning (conjunctivitis). Sensitive to light (photophobia). Eyes suffused and watery; profuse, bland lachrymation, better in open air. Buming in eyelids.

sections.title: Ears
sections.content: Otalgia, shooting in the eustachian tube.

sections.title: Nose
sections.content: Sneezing, especially when entering a warm room. Copious, watery and extremely acrid discharge. Sensation of a lump at the root of the nose. Hay fever (Sabad.; Sil.; Psor.). Fluent coryza with headache, cough, and hoarseness. Polypus.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Canine hunger.        Pain in the pyloric region.     Thirst. Belching. Nausea.

sections.title: Abdomen
sections.content: Rumbling, offensive flatus. Pain in the left hypo- gastrium (inguinal hemia)}. Colic worse sitting, better moving about.

sections.title: Rectum
sections.content: Diarrhea with very offensive flatus. Stitches in the rectum; itching and rhagades (fissures) in the anus. Glowing heat in the rectum.

sections.title: Urinary
sections.content: Sensation of weakness in the bladder and urethra. Increased secretion of urine with coryza. Urine red with much pressure and buming in the urethra.

sections.title: Respiratory
sections.content: Hoarseness. Hacking cough.on inspiring cold air. Tickling in the larynx. Sensation as if larynx is split or torn (laryngitis). Oppressed breathing from pressure in the middle of the chest. Constricted feeling in the region of epiglottis. Pain extending to the ear.

sections.title: Extremities

intro: An excellent remedy to aid in re-establishing physiological equilib- rium after over dosing, where disease and drug symptoms are mixed. There is no remedy richer in symptoms of portal congestion and none that has given better clinical results, both for the primary pathological condi- tion and secondary phenomena. Bad effects from sedentary life or habits. Especially suitable to lymphatic and hypochondriacal patients. The rectal symptoms usually determine the choice. Adapted to weary people, aged, phlegmatic, and old beer drinkers. Dissatisfied and angry about himself, alternating with lumbago. Heat intemal and external. Has been used successfully in the treatment of consumption by giving the pure juice. Aloe socotrina | 831A

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Headache altemates with lumbago, with intestinal and uterine affections. Disinclination to mental labour. Aches above fore- head, with heaviness in eyes, must close them partially. Headache after stool. Dull, pressive pain: worse from heat.

sections.title: Eyes
sections.content: Compelled to close the eyes during pain in the forehead. Flickering before eyes. Redness of eyes with yellow vision. Pain deep in the orbits.

sections.title: Ears
sections.content: Cracking when chewing. Sudden explosion and clashing in left ear.' Tinkling as if some thin, metallic globe is in the head.

sections.title: Nose
sections.content: Coldness of the tip. Epistaxis in the moming on waking up. Full of crusts.

sections.title: Face
sections.content: Marked redness of lips.

sections.title: Mouth
sections.content: Taste bitter and sour. Tasteless eructations. Lips cracked and dry. .

sections.title: Throat
sections.content: Thick lumps of tough mucus.          Varicose condition of veins in the pharynx. Dry, scrapy feeling.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Aversion to meat. Longing for juicy things. After eating, flatulence, pulsation in the rectum, and sexual imtation. Nausea, with headache. Pain in the pit of stomach from a misstep.

sections.title: Abdomen
sections.content: Pulsating pain around the navel, worse pressure, Full- ness in the region of the liver, pain under the right ribs or in the right hypochondrium. Abdomen feels full, heavy, hot, bloated. Weak feeling, as if diarrhea would come on. Great accumulation of flatus, pressing downwards, causes distress in the lower bowels. Sensation of a plug between symphysis pubis and os coccygis, with urging to pass stool. Colic before and during stools. Buming, copious flatus.

sections.title: Rectum
sections.content: Constant bearing down in the rectum; bleeding, sore, and hot; relieved by cold water. Feeling of weakness and loss of power of sphincter ani. Sense of insecurity of rectum when passing flatus. Uncer- tain whether gas or stool will come. Stooi passes without an effort, almost unnoticed. Lumpy, watery stool. Jelly like stools, with soreness of the rectum after stool. A lot of mucus is passed after stool with proctalgia. Haemorthoids protrude like grapes; very sore and tender; better cold water application. Burning in the anus and rectum. Constipation, with heavy pressure in the lower part of the abdomen. Diarrhea from beer. ‘As from breaking of glass (Clarke - Dictionary of Practical Materia Medica). A 32 Aloe socotrina e@ Alstonia scholaris

sections.title: Urinary
sections.content: Incontinence in aged, bearing down sensation and en- larged prostate. Scanty and highly coloured urine.

sections.title: Female
sections.content: Bearing down pain in the rectum, worse standing and during menses. Uterus feels heavy, cannot walk much on that account. Labor like pains in loins; extend down the legs. Climacteric haemorrhage. Menses too early and too profuse (menorrhagia).

sections.title: Respiratory
sections.content: Winter coughs, with itching. Difficult respiration, with stitches from liver to chest.

sections.title: Back
sections.content: Pain in the lumbosacral region, worse motion. Stitches through the sacrum. Lumbago alternating with headache and piles.

sections.title: Extremities
sections.content: Lameness in all limbs. Drawing pains in joints. Soles pain when walking. ‘ Modalities — Worse, early moming; summer; heat; in hot, dry weather; after eating or drinking. Better, from cold, open air.

Urinary — Incontinence in aged, bearing down sensation and en- larged prostate. Scanty and highly coloured urine.

Respiratory — Winter coughs, with itching. Difficult respiration, with stitches from liver to chest.
Back — Pain in the lumbosacral region, worse motion. Stitches through the sacrum. Lumbago alternating with headache and piles.
Extremities — Lameness in all limbs. Drawing pains in joints. Soles pain when walking. ‘ Modalities — Worse, early moming; summer; heat; in hot, dry weather; after eating or drinking. Better, from cold, open air.

name: Alstonia Scholaris
author: Boericke
intro: Malarial diseases, with diarrhea, dysentery, anaemia, and feeble digestion, are the general conditions suggesting this remedy. Character- istic symptoms are the all gone sensation in the stomach and sinking in the abdomen, with debility. A tonic after exhausting fevers.

sections.title: Abdomen
sections.content: Violent purging and cramps in bowels. Heat and imitation in lower bowels. Camp diarrhea, (diarrhea due to contaminated water as during camps), bloody stool, dysentery; diarrhea from bad water and malaria. Painless watery stools (Ph-ac.). Diarrhea immediately after eating. Relationship — Compare: Similar in action to Alstonia constricta, the bitter bark or native quinine of Australia. Ditainum (active principle, is anti-penodic, like quinine, but without unpleasant effects). Cinchona officinalis (similar in diarrhea, chronic dyspepsia and debility). Hydr.; Ferr cit. et chin. Alumen 33 A Dose — Tincture to third potency. Locally, for ulcers and rheumatic - pains.

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Burning pain as if a weight was put on top of the head, better by pressure of hand. Vertigo, with weakness in the pit of the stomach. Alopecia.

sections.title: Throat

sections.title: Rectum
sections.content: Constipation of the most aggravated kind. No desire for stool for days. Violent ineffectual urging to stool. No ability to expel stools. sections.title: Female
sections.content: Tendency to induration of the neck of the uterus and mammary glands (Carb-an.; Con.). Chronic yellow vaginal discharge. Chronic gonorrhea, yellow, with little lumps along the urethra. Aphthous patches in the vagina (Caul.). Menses watery.

sections.title: Respiratory
sections.content: Haemoptysis, great weakness of the chest; difficult to expel mucus. Copious, ropy, moming expectoration in old people. Asthma.

sections.title: Heart
sections.content: Palpitations, from lying down on the right side,

sections.title: Extremities
sections.content: Weakness of all muscles, especially arms and legs. Constricted feeling around limbs. A 34 Alumen e Alumina

sections.title: Skin
sections.content: Ulcers, with indurated bases. To be thought of in indurated glands, epithelioma, etc.; veins become varicosed and bleed. Indurations resulting from long continued, inflammatory imitations. Glands inflame and harden. Alopecia, scrotal eczema and on the dorsum of penis. name: Alumina
author: Boericke
intro:
(Oxide of Aluminum—Argilla) Alum. -

A very general condition corresponding to this drug is dryness of the mucous membranes and skin, and a tendency to paretic muscular states. Old people, with lack of vital heat, or the prematurely old, with debility. Sluggish functions, heaviness, numbness, staggering, and the character- istic constipation find an excellent remedy in Alumina. Disposition to colds in the head, and eructations in spare, dry, thin subjects. Delicate children, products of artificial baby foods.

sections.title: Mind
sections.content: Low spirited; fears loss of reason. Confused about their personal identity. Hasty, hurried. Time passes slowly. Variable mood. Better as day advances. Suicidal tendency on seeing a knife or blood.

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Stitching, buming pain in the head, with vertigo, worse in the moming, but relieved by food. Pressure in the forehead, as if from a tight hat. Inability to walk except with eyes open. Throbbing headache, with constipation. Vertigo, with nausea; better after breakfast. Falling hair; scalp itches and is numb.

sections.title: Eyes
sections.content: Objects look yellow. Eyes feel cold. Lids dry, bum, smart, thickened, aggravation in the moming; chronic conjunctivitis. Ptosis. Strabismus. Ears — Humming; roaring. Eustachian tube feels plugged.

sections.title: Nose
sections.content: Pain at the root of the nose. Sense of smell diminished. Fluent coryza. Tip of nose cracked, nostrils sore, red; worse touch. Scabs with thick yellow mucus. Tettery redness. Ozaena atrophica sicca. Mem- branes distended and boggy. Face — Feels as if an albuminous substance had dried on it. Blood- Alumina 35 A boils and pimples. Twitchings of the lower jaw. Rush of blood to the face after eating.

sections.title: Mouth
sections.content: Sore. Bad odor from it (halitosis). Teeth covered with sordes. Gums sore, bleeding. Tensive pain in the articulation of jaw when opening the mouth or chewing.

sections.title: Throat
sections.content: Dry, sore; food cannot pass, oesophagus contracted. a splinter or plug in the throat. Irritable, and relaxed throat. Looks parched and glazed. Clergyman’s sore throat in thin subjects. Thick, tenacious mucus drops from posterior nares. Constant inclination to clear the throat.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Abnormal cravings, chalk, charcoal, dry food, tea-grounds. Heartbum; feels constricted. Aversion to meat (Graph.; Arn.; Puls.). Potatoes disagree. No desire to eat. Can swallow, but small morsels at a time. Constriction of the oesophagus.

sections.title: Abdomen
sections.content: Colic, like painter's colic. Pressing in both            groins toward sexual organs. Left sided abdominal complaints.

sections.title: Stool
sections.content: Hard, dry, knotty stools; no desire. Rectum sore, dry, inflamed, bleeding. Itching and buming in the anus. Even a soft stool is passed with difficulty. Great straining. Constipation in infants (Coll.; Psor.; Paraf.) and old people from an inactive rectum, and in women with very sedentary habits. Diarrhea on micturating. Evacuation preceded by painful urging long before stool, and then straining at stool.

sections.title: Urinary
sections.content: Muscles of bladder paretic, must strain at stool in order to micturate. Pain in kidneys, with mental confusion. Frequent desire to micturate in old people. Difficult starting.

sections.title: Male
sections.content: Excessive desire. Involuntary emissions when straining at stool. Prostatic discharge.

sections.title: Female
sections.content: Menses too early, short, scanty, pale, followed by great exhaustion (Carb-an.; Cocc.). Leucorrhea acrid, profuse, transparent, ropy, with buming; worse during daytime, and after menses. Relieved by washing with cold water.

sections.title: Respiratory
sections.content: Cough soon after waking in the moming. Hoarseness, aphonia, tickling in the larynx; wheezing, rattling respiration. Cough on talking or singing, in the morning. Chest feels constricted. Condiments produce cough. Talking aggravates soreness of chest.

sections.title: Back
sections.content: Stitches” Gnawing pain, as if from a hot iron. Pain along the cord, with paralytic weakness.

sections.title: Extremities
sections.content: Pain in the arms and fingers, as if hot iron had A 36 Alumina e Alumina silicata penetrated. Arms feel paralyzed. Legs fall asleep, especially when sitting with legs crossed. Staggers on walking (locomotor ataxia). Heels feel numb. Soles tender; on stepping, feel soft and swollen. Pain in shoulder and upper arm. Gnawing beneath finger nails. Brittle nails. Inability to walk, except when eyes are open or in daytime. Spinal degenerations and paralysis of lower limbs. Sleep — Restless; anxious and confused dreams. Sleepy in the moming. Skin — Chapped, dry tettery. Brittle nails. Intolerable itching when getting warm in bed. Must scratch till it bleeds; then becomes painful. Brittle skin on fingers. Modalities — Worse, periodically; in the afternoon; from potatoes. Worse, in the moming on waking up; in a warm room. Better, in open air; from cold washing; in the evening and on alternate days. Better, damp weather. Relationship — Compare: Aluminium chloridum (pains of locomotor ataxia. Lower triturations in water). Slag-Aluminium silico sulpho calcite 3x (anal itching, piles, constipation, flatulent distention}; Sec.; Lath.; Plb. Aluminium acetate solution (extemally a lotion for putrid wounds and skin infections. Arrests haemorrhage from inertia of uterus. Parenchymatous haemorrhage from various organs 2-3% solution. Haemorrhage following tonsillectomy is controlled by nnsing out the nasopharynx with a 10% solution). Complementary: Bry. Antidotes: Ip.; Cham. Dose — Sixth to thirtieth and higher. Action slow to develop.

name: Alumina Silicata
author: Boericke
modalities: Worse, cold air, after eating, standing. Better, warmth, fasting, resting in bed.
intro:
Alum-sil.

Deep acting remedy for chronic complaints of brain, spine and nerves. Constriction is a marked general symptom, especially of the orifices. Venous distention. Weakness, especially spinal. Aching and buming in the spine. Formication, numbness, pain in all the limbs. Epileptiform convulsion. Coldness during pains. Alumina silicata e Ambra grisea 37A

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Congestion of brain. Constriction of the scalp. Pain in the head, better heat, perspiration.

sections.title: Eyes
sections.content: Pain in the eyes; flickering before the eyes.

sections.title: Nose
sections.content: Frequent coryzas. Swelling and ulceration of the nose (ozaena). Itching and buming. Discharge yellow. Sore, scabby, stopped up.

sections.title: Respiratory
sections.content: Catarrh, pain, raw feeling. sensation of great weak- ness in the chest. Stitching pains. Spasmodic cough with purulent viscid expectoration. Soreness of the chest, along the trachea; cannot stand percussion. Gray sputum. Capillary bronchitis. Larynx and chest sore. Membranous croup extends to the trachea.

sections.title: Extremities
sections.content: Heaviness, jerking, numbness, aching and pains.

sections.title: Skin
sections.content: Formication along the course of nerves, veins feel full and distended. Sore to touch and pressure.

sections.title: Modalities
sections.content: Worse, cold air, after eating, standing. Better, warmth, fasting, resting in bed.

sections.title: Dose
sections.content: Higher potencies.

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Slow comprehension. Vertigo, with weakness in the head and stomach. Pressure on the front part of head with mental depression. sections.title: Urinary

intro: The diseased conditions met by this remedy are such that are often found in rather stout women who are always tired and weary, take cold easily, suffer from cholera like symptoms before menses, lead a sedentary life, have a slow reaction generally and are disposed to the frequent use of a smelling bottle. Too frequent and profuse menses. Mucous membranes of the respiratory organs are especially affected. Fat patients with weak hearts, wheezing, feel suffocated. Very sensitive to cold air. Great aversion to water; cannot bear to touch it. Malignant scarlatina, with somnolence, swollen glands, dark red sore throat, faintly developed eruptions. Uremia. Heaviness inall organs. Uncleanliness in bodily habits. Swelling of parts, glands, etc. Acid secretions. Prostration from trifles.

sections.title: Mind
sections.content: Forgetful, ill humored, gloomy during stormy weather, Uncleanliness. Talking and hearing others talk, affects greatly. Sad, lachrimose, unreasonable.

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Pulsating forehead; better, by pressure and in a warm room. Shocks through the head.

sections.title: Eyes
sections.content: Buming in eyes with an aversion to light (photophobia). Eye strain (Nat- m.). Asthenopia. Sore canthi.

sections.title: Ears
sections.content: Hardness of hearing. Shocks through ears, eyes, and nose, when gnashing teeth.

sections.title: Nose
sections.content: Sharp, watery discharge. Buming. Stoppage at night, with long continuous coryza. Cannot breathe through the nose. Snuffles in children. Epistaxis after washing and after eating. Ozaena, blows bloody mucus from the nose. Tip of nose congested. H. M. M. -5 A 42 Ammonium carbonicum

sections.title: Face
sections.content: Tetters around mouth. Boils and pustules, during menses. Comers of mouth sore, cracked, and bum.

sections.title: Mouth
sections.content: Great dryness of mouth and throat. Toothache. Pressing teeth together sends shocks through the head, eyes and ears. Vesicles on the tongue. Taste sour; metallic. Cracking of jaw on chewing.

sections.title: Throat
sections.content: Enlarged tonsils and glands of neck. Buming pain down the throat. Tendency to gangrenous ulceration of tonsils. Diphtheria when nose is stopped up.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Pain in the pit of the stomach, with heartbum, nausea, waterbrash, and chilliness. Great appetite, but easily satisfied. Flatulent dyspepsia.

sections.title: Abdomen
sections.content: Noise and pain in the abdomen. Flatulent hemia.

sections.title: Rectum
sections.content: Stools difficult, hard, and knotty. Bleeding piles; worse during menses. Itching in the anus. Protruding piles, worse after stool, better lying down.

sections.title: Urinary
sections.content: Frequent desire; involuntary at night. Tenesmus of bladder. Urine white, sandy, bloody, copious, turbid and fetid.

sections.title: Male
sections.content: Itching and pain in the scrotum and spermatic cords. Erection without desire. Seminal emissions.

sections.title: Female
sections.content: Itching, swelling and buming of pudendum. Leucorrhea buming, acrid, watery. Aversion to the other sex. Menses too frequent, profuse, early (menorrhagia), copious, clotted, black; colicky pains (dysmenorrhea), with hard, difficult stool and fatigue, especially of thighs; yawning and chilliness. . Respiratory — Hoarseness. Cough every moming around three o'clock, with dyspnea, palpitations, burning in the chest; worse ascending. Chest feels tired. Emphysema. Oppression during breathing; worse after any effort, and on entering a warm room, or ascending even a few steps (asthma). Asthenic pneumonia. Slow laboured, stertorous breathing; bubbling sound (rattling). Winter catarrh, with slimy sputum and specks of blood (haemoptysis). Pulmonary oedema. Heart — Audible palpitations with fear, cold sweat, lachrymation, inability to speak, loud breathing and trembling hands. Heart weak, awakens with difficult breathing and palpitations. Extremities — Tearing in joints relieved by heat of bed; inclination to stretch limbs. Hands cold and blue; distended veins. Fingers swell when arm is hanging down. Panaritium, deep seated periosteal pain: Ammonium carbonicum e Ammonium causticum 43 A Cramps in calves and soles. Big toe painful and swollen (gout). Felons in the beginning. Heel painful on standing. Tearing in ankles and bones of feet, better when warm in bed.

sections.title: Sleep
sections.content: Sleepiness during the day. Starts from sleep, stranglulated.

sections.title: Skin
sections.content: Violent itching and buming blisters. Scarlet rash. Miliary rash. Malignant scarlatina. Faintly developed eruptions from defective Vitality. Erysipelas in the aged, with mental symptoms. Eczema in the bends of extremities, between legs, around the anus and genitals.

sections.title: Modalities
sections.content: Worse, evenings, from cold, wet weather, wet applications, washing, between 3 to 4 a. m. and during menses. Better, lying on painful side and on stomach; in dry weather.

sections.content: lower potencies deteriorate with age. Sixth potency best for general use.

(Hydrate of Ammonia-Ammonia Water) Am-caust.

This is a powerful cardiac stimulant. Useful in syncope, thrombosis, haemorhage, snake bites, chloroform narcosis; may be given by inhalation. sections.title: Extremities
sections.content: Excessive exhaustion and muscular debility. Rheu- matism of shoulders. Skin hot and dry.

name: Ammonium         Muriaticum
author: Boericke
modalities: Better, open air. Worse, head and chest symptoms in the moming; abdominal symptoms in the aftemoon.
relationships: Antidotes: Coff.; Nux-v.; Caust. Compare: Calc.; Seneg.; Caust.
intro: Astate of prostration bordering on a typhoid state is produced by this remedy. All mucous secretions are increased and retained. It is especially adapted to fat and sluggish patients who have respiratory problems. Cough associated with catarrh and liver affections. Tendency to irregular circulation, blood seems to be in a constant turmoi, pulsations, etc. Many groups of symptoms are accompanied by cough and profuse glairy secretions. Periods of aggravation are peculiarly divided according to the bodily region affected; thus the head and chest symptoms are worse in the mornings, the abdominal, in the afternoon, pain in the limbs, skin and febrile symptoms, in the evenings. “Boiling” sensation.

sections.title: Mind
sections.content: Melancholy, apprehension; from intemal grief. Desire to cry, but cannot. Consequences of grief.

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Hair falls out, with itching and dandruff.      Feels full, compressed; worse momings.

sections.title: Eyes
sections.content: Mist before eyes, optical illusions in incipient cataract; capsular cataract.

sections.title: Nose
sections.content: Free, acrid, hot, watery discharge corroding the lip. Sneezing. Nose sore to touch; ulcerative pain in the nostrils. Loss of smell (anosmia). Obstructed, stuffy feeling; constant and unavailing efforts to blow it out. Itchy.

sections.title: Face
sections.content: Inflammation, eruptions on the face. Faceache.'      Mouth and lips sore and exconiated. ‘Sensation of tearing in the zygomatic bone (T.F. Allen — Handbook of Materia Medica). Ammonium muriaticum 45A

sections.title: Throat
sections.content: Throbbing in, and swelling of tonsils, can scarcely swallow. Tonsillitis. Sore spot behind uvula, relieved by eating. Internal and extemal swelling of throat with viscid phlegm. So tough, that it cannot be hawked up. Stricture of oesophagus.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Thirst for lemonade, regurgitation of food, bitter waterbrash. Nausea. Gnawing in stomach. Epigastric pain immediately after eating. Cancer of stomach.

sections.title: Abdomen
sections.content: Stitches in the region of spleen, especially in the moming, with difficulty in respiration. Pain around the navel. Abdominal symptoms appear during pregnancy. Chronic congestion of liver. Excessive fatty deposit around the abdomen. Much flatus. Strained feeling in groin.

sections.title: Rectum
sections.content: Itching and haemorthoids, soreness with pustules. Hard, crumbly stool, or covered with glairy mucus. Stinging in perineum. Green mucoid stools alternate with constipation. During and after stool, buming and smarting in the rectum. Haemorrhoids after suppressed leucorrhea.

sections.title: Female
sections.content: Menses too early, too free, dark, clotted; flow more at night {menorthagia}. Pain as if sprained, in the left side of abdomen, during pregnancy. Diarrhea, greenish mucoid stools, and pain around the navel during menses. Leucorrhea, like white of an egg (Alum.; Borx.;

sections.title: Calc
sections.content: p.); with pain around the navel; brown, slimy after every passage of urine.

sections.title: Respiratory
sections.content: Hoarseness and burning in larynx. Dry, hacking, scraping cough; worse lying on the back or on the night side. Stitches in the chest. Cough loose in the aftemoon, with profuse expectoration and rattling of mucus. Oppression of chest. Buming in small spots in the chest. Scanty expectoration. Cough with profuse salivation.

sections.title: Back
sections.content: Icy coldness between shoulders; not relieved by a warm covering, followed by itching. Bruised pain in coccyx; backache, as if in a vise when sitting.

sections.title: Extremities
sections.content: Pain as from ulcerations on the finger tips. Shooting and tearing pains in the tips of the fingers and toes. Ulcerative pain in heels. Contraction of hamstring tendons. Sciatica, worse sitting, better lying. Neuralgic pain in amputated limbs. Offensive sweaty feet. Pain in feet during menses.

sections.title: Fever
sections.content: Chills during the evenings after lying down and on awakening, without thirst. Palms and soles hot. Sub-acute, low fever due to unhealthy climate. Lowest potencies. A 46 Ammonium phosphoricum @ Ammonium picricum

sections.title: Skin
sections.content: Itching, generally in the evenings. Blisters on various parts. Intense buming better, cold applications.

sections.title: Modalities
sections.content: Better, open air. Worse, head and chest symptoms in the moming; abdominal symptoms in the aftemoon.

sections.content: Third to sixth potency.

Stomach — Thirst for lemonade, regurgitation of food, bitter waterbrash. Nausea. Gnawing in stomach. Epigastric pain immediately after eating. Cancer of stomach.
Abdomen — Stitches in the region of spleen, especially in the moming, with difficulty in respiration. Pain around the navel. Abdominal symptoms appear during pregnancy. Chronic congestion of liver. Excessive fatty deposit around the abdomen. Much flatus. Strained feeling in groin.
Rectum — Itching and haemorthoids, soreness with pustules. Hard, crumbly stool, or covered with glairy mucus. Stinging in perineum. Green mucoid stools alternate with constipation. During and after stool, buming and smarting in the rectum. Haemorrhoids after suppressed leucorrhea.
Female — Menses too early, too free, dark, clotted; flow more at night {menorthagia}. Pain as if sprained, in the left side of abdomen, during pregnancy. Diarrhea, greenish mucoid stools, and pain around the navel during menses. Leucorrhea, like white of an egg (Alum.; Borx.;
Calc — p.); with pain around the navel; brown, slimy after every passage of urine.
Respiratory — Hoarseness and burning in larynx. Dry, hacking, scraping cough; worse lying on the back or on the night side. Stitches in the chest. Extremities — Pain as from ulcerations on the finger tips. Shooting and tearing pains in the tips of the fingers and toes. Ulcerative pain in heels. Contraction of hamstring tendons. Syphilitic patients often suffer with these conditions. Intermittency of symptoms. Fear of examination in students. author: Boericke
intro: A remedy for mucous membranes. Chronic forms of inflammation of the Schneiderian membrane with considerable relaxation and profuse discharge. Of chief value in catarrhal states, with a full, stuffy sensation in the head and throat. Useful in cuts, bruises and sprains; as a diuretic and in malaria. Not yet proven, but found useful in profuse mucous or serous discharges; in nasal and pharyngeal catarrh, diarrhea and urethritis. Recommended in heart disease, as a relaxing agent when unduly excited. Flatulence; promotes digestion. Relationship — Compare Pip-m. Dose — Tincture intemally and locally as a spray.

sections.title: Mind

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Aching, worse in the vertex, on ascending, from bathing, from a disordered stomach, especially from eating candy or drinking acid wines. Suppressed eruptions. Heaviness of the forehead with vertigo; nausea, and epistaxis. Headache with great loss of hair.

sections.title: Eyes
sections.content: Dull, sunken, red, itch, inflamed, agglutinated. Canthi raw and fissured. Chronic blepharitis. Pustules on the comea and lids.

sections.title: Ears
sections.content: Redness; swelling; pain in the eustachian tube. Ringing and deafness. Moist eruptions around the ear.

sections.title: Nose
sections.content: Nostrils chapped and covered with crusts. Eczema of nostrils, sore, cracked and scurfy.

sections.title: Face
sections.content: Pimples, pustules, and boils on the face. Yellow crusty eruptions on cheeks and chin. Sallow and haggard looking face. Antimonium crudum 57A

sections.title: Mouth

Toothache in hollow teeth. Rawness of palate, with expectoration of much mucus. Canker sores. Pappy taste. No thirst. Subacute eczema around the mouth.

sections.title: Throat
sections.content: Thick, yellowish mucus from posterior nares. Hawking in open air. Laryngitis. Rough voice from over use.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Loss of appetite. Desire for acids, pickles. Thirst in the evening and at night. Eructations tasting of the ingesta (dyspepsia). Heartbum, nausea, vomiting. After nursing, the child vomits milk as curds, refuses to nurse afterwards, and is very cross. Gastric and intestinal complaints from bread and pastry, acids, sour wine, cold bathing, overheating, hot weather. Constant belching. Gouty metastasis to stomach and bowels. Sweetish waterbrash. Bloating after eating.

sections.title: Stool
sections.content: Anal itching. Diarrhea alternates with constipation, espe- cially in old people. Diarrhea after acids, sour wine, baths, overeating; slimy, flatulent stools. Mucoid piles, continuous oozing of mucus. Hard lumps mixed with watery discharge. Catarrhal proctitis. Stools composed entirely of mucus. ; Urinary — Frequent, with buming, and backache; turbid and foul odor. Male — Eruptions gn the scrotum and around the genitals. Impo- tence. Atrophy of penis and testicles.

sections.title: Female
sections.content: Excited; parts itch. Before menses, toothache; menses too early and profuse (menorrhagia}. Menses suppressed from cold bathing, with sensation of pressure in the pelvis and tendemess in the ovarian region. Leucorrhea watery; acrid, lumpy.

sections.title: Respiratory
sections.content: Cough worse coming into a warm room, with a burning sensation in the chest, itching of chest, oppression. Aphonia from becoming overheated. Voice harsh and badly pitched.

sections.title: Back
sections.content: Itching and pain in the neck and back.

sections.title: Extremities
sections.content: Twitching of muscles (chorea). Jerks in arms. Arthritic pain in fingers. Nails brittle; grow out of shape. Homy warts on hands and soles. Weakness and shaking of hands when writing, followed by offensive flatulence. ‘Feet very tender; covered with large homy coms. Inflamed coms. Pain in the heels (callosities).

sections.title: Sleep
sections.content: Continuous drowsiness in old people. A 58 Antimonium crudum @e Antimonium sulphuratum auratum

sections.title: Fever
sections.content: Chilly, even in a warm room. Intermittent with disgust, nausea, vomiting, eructations, coated tongue, diarrhea. Hot sweat.

sections.title: Skin

name: Antimonium Tartaricum
common: Tartar Emetic, Tartrate of Antimony and Potash
author: Boericke
modalities: Worse, in the evening; from lying down at night; from warmth; in damp cold weather; from all sour things and milk. Better, from sitting erect; from eructation and expectoration. Relationship — Antidotes: Puls.; Sep. Compare: Kali-s.; Ip. Dose — Second and sixth trituration. The lower potencies sometimes aggravate. Antipyrinum 61A
intro: Has many symptoms in common with Antimonium crudum, but has its own characteristic simptoms. Clinically, its therapeutic application has been confined, largely to the treatment of respiratory diseases, rattling of mucus with little expectoration has been a guiding symptom. Drowsiness, debility and sweat are characteristic to the drug. Gastric affections of drunkards and gouty subjects. Cholera morbus. Sensation of coldness in blood vessels. Bilharziasis. Ant-t. is homoeopathic to dysuna, strangury, haematuria, albuminuria, catarrh of bladder and urethra (cystitis, urethritis), buming in the rectum, bloody mucous stools, etc. Ant-t. acts indirectly on the parasites by stimulating the oxidizing action of the protective substance. Side effects following injection for bilharziasis. Chills, contractures and pain in muscles. Trembling of the whole body, great prostration and faintness. Lumbago. Warts on glans penis.

sections.title: Mind

sections.title: Mouth
sections.content: Tongue coated, pasty, thick white, with red edges. Red and dry, especially in the center. Brown.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Difficult deglutition of liquids. Vomiting in any position, except when lying on the right side. sections.title: Abdomen
sections.content: Spasmodic colic, much flatus. Pressure in the abdomen, A 60 Antimonium tartaricum especially on bending forward. Cholera morbu:. Diarrhea in eruptive diseases.

sections.title: Urinary
sections.content: Buming in urethra during and afier micturition. Last drops bloody with pain in the bladder. Frequent urging. Catarh of bladder and urethra. Stricture. Orchitis.

sections.title: Respiratory
sections.content: Hoarseness. Great rattling of mucus, but very little is expectorated. Velvety feeling inthe chest. Buming sensation in the chest, which ascends to the throat. author: Boericke

intro: Acts on cellular tissues causing oedema of skin and mucous membranes. The very characteristic effects of a bee sting fumish, unerring indications for its employment in disease. Swelling or puffing up of various parts, oedema, red rosy hue, stinging pains, soreness, intolerance of heat and slightest touch, and aftemoon aggravation are some of the general guiding symptoms. Erysipelatous inflammations, dropsical effu- sions and anasarca, acute inflammation of kidneys and other paren- chymatous tissues are characteristic pathological states corresponding to Apis. Apis acts especially on the outer parts, skin, coatings of inner organs, serous membranes, etc. It produces serous inflammation with effusions in the membranes, of brain, heart, pleura, etc. Extreme sensitiveness to touch and general soreness is marked. Constricted sensations. Sensation of stiffness and as if something is tom off from inside the body. Marked prostration. Mind — Apathy, indifference, and unconsciousness. Awkward; drops things readily. Stupor, with sharp cries and starts suddenly. Stupor alternating with erotic mania. Sensation of dying. Listless; cannot think clearly. Jealous, fidgety, hard to please. Sudden shmill, piercing screams. Whining. Tearful. Jealousy, fright, rage, vexation, gnef. Cannot concentrate when attempting to read or study.

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Brain feels very tired. Vertigo with sneezing, worse on lying down or closing the eyes. Heat, throbbing, pressing pains, better on pressure, and worse on motion. Sudden stabbing pain. Dull, heavy sensation in the occiput, as if from a blow, extending to the neck (better on pressure}, accompanied with sexual excitement. Bores head into pillow and screams out.'.

sections.title: Eyes
sections.content: Lids swollen, red, oedematous, everted, inflamed; bum and sting (blepharitis). Conjunctiva bright red, puffy (conjunctivitis). Lachrymation, hot. Photophobia. Sudden piercing pains (optic neuritis). Pain around the orbits. Serous exudation, oedema, and sharp pains. Suppurative inflammation of eyes. Keratitis with intense chemosis of ' Especially in meningitis and tubercular hydrocephalus (T. F. Allen—Handbook of Matena Media). Apis mellifica 63 A ocular conjunctiva. Staphyloma of comea following suppurative inflammation. Styes, prevents their recurrence.

sections.title: Ears
sections.content: Extemal ear red, inflamed, sore; stinging pains.

sections.title: Nose
sections.content: Coldness of the tip of the nose. Red, swollen inflamed, with sharp pains.

sections.title: Face
sections.content: Swollen, red, with piercing pain. Waxy, pale, oedematous. Erysipelas with stinging, buming oedema. Extends from right to left.

sections.title: Mouth
sections.content: Tongue fiery red, swollen, sore, and raw, with vesicles {glossitis). Scalding in the mouth and throat. Tongue feels scalded, red hot, trembling. Gums swollen. Lips swollen, especially upper. Membrane of mouth and throat glossy, as if vamished. Red, shining, and puffy, like erysipelas. Cancer of the tongue.

sections.title: Throat
sections.content: Constricted, stinging pains. Uvula swollen, sac like. Throat swollen, inside and out; tonsils swollen, puffy, fiery red (tonsillitis). Ulcers on tonsils (quinsy). Fiery red margin around a leathery membrane (diptheria). Sensation of a fishbone in the throat.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Sore feeling. Thirstless. Vomiting of food. Craving for milk (Rhus-t.).

sections.title: Abdomen
sections.content: Sore, bruised on pressure, when. sneezing. Extremely tender. Dropsy of the abdomen (ascitis). Peritonitis. Swelling in right groin (inguinal hemia).

sections.title: Stool
sections.content: Involuntary stools on every motion; anus seems open. Bloody, painless. Anus feels raw. Haemorrhoids, with stinging pain, after confinement. Diarrhea watery, yellow; cholera infantum type. Cannot micturate without passing stool. Dark, fetid, worse after eating. Constipation; feels as if something would break on straining.

sections.title: Urinary
sections.content: Buming and soreness when micturating. Suppressed, loaded with casts; frequent and involuntary; stinging pain and strangury; scanty, high coloured. Incontinence. Last few drops bum and smart.

sections.title: Female
sections.content: Oedema of labia; relieved by cold water. Soreness and stinging pains; ovaritis; worse in right ovary. Menses suppressed, with cerebral and head symptoms, especially in young girls. Dysmenorrhea, with severe ovarian pains. Metrorrhagia profuse, with heaviness of the abdomen, faintness and stinging pain. Sense of tightness. Bearing down, as if menses were to-appedr. Ovarian tumors (cysts), metntis with stinging pains. Great tenderness in the abdomen, over the uterine region.

sections.title: Respiratory
sections.content: Hoarseness; dyspnea, breathing hurried and difficult. Oedema of larynx (laryngitis). Feels as if he could not draw another A 64 Apis mellifica e Apium graveolens breath (pleurisy). Suffocation; short, dry cough, suprastemnal. Hydrotho- Tax. Extremities — Oedematous. Synovitis. Felons in the beginning. Knee swollen, shiny, sensitive, sore, with stinging pain. Feet swollen and stiff. Feels too large. Rheumatic pain in the back and limbs. Tired, bruised feeling. Numbness of hands and finger tips. Hives with intolerable itching. Oedematous swellings (cellulitis, erysipelas). Sleep — Very drowsy. Dreams full of care and toil. Screams and sudden starting during sleep. Fever — Afternoon chill, with thirst; worse on motion and heat. External heat, with a smothering sensation. Sweat stage absent or very slight, with sleepiness. Sleeps after the fever paroxysm. After perspiration, nettle rash, with shuddering. Skin — Swellings after bites; sore, sensitive. Stinging. Erysipelas, with sensitiveness and swelling, rosy hue. Carbuncles, with buming, stinging pain (Ars.; Anthraci.). Sudden puffing up of the whole body (cellulitis).

name: Apomorphinum Hypochloricum
common: Alkaloid from Decomposition of Morphine by Hydrochloric Acid
author: Boericke
intro:
Apom.

The chief power of this drug lies in the speedy and effective vomiting that it produces, which becomes a strong guiding symptom for its homoeopathic use. The vomiting is preceded by nausea, lassitude and increased secretion of sweat, saliva, mucus and tears. Pneumonia with vomiting. Alcoholism, with constant nausea, constipation, insomnia.

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Vertigo. Dilated pupils. Feels hot, all over the body, especially in the head.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Empty retching and headache; heartbum; pain between shoulder blades. Reflex vomiting of pregnancy. Seasickness. Nausea and vomiting. Violent inclination to vomit.

sections.title: Non
sections.content: Homoeopathic Uses — The hypodermic injection of one sixteenth of a grain will cause full emesis within five to fifteen minutes in an adult without developing any other direct action apparently. Do not use in opium poisoning. Apom. hypodermically, one-thirtieth grain or less, acts as a safe and sure hypnotic. Acts well even in delirium. Sleep comes on in half an hour.

sections.title: Dose
sections.content: Third to sixth potency.

name: Aragallus Lamberti
author: Boericke
intro: Acts principally on the nervous system, producing a bewildered, confused state. Symptoms of incoordination and paralysis. Locomotor ataxia. Tired in the moming. Mind — Great depression; worse in the moming or in the evening. Cannot study. Cross, irritable, restless. Bewildered. Mental confusion and apathy. Desires to be alone. Difficulty in concentrating the mind, absent minded. Lack of ambition. Defective expression in writing. Restlessness and aimless wandering. Must concentrate on his walking. Eyes — Diplopia. Burning in eyes. Face — Cracking of lower lip. Throat — Aches. feels full, Sore with nausea. Pharynx dark, swollen, glazed (pharyngitis). Respiratory — Weight on chest, in the region of ensiform cartilage. Constriction with a sensation of a wide band across the chest. Soreness of the chest under the sternum. Oppression. Extremities — Weakness of limbs. Pain in left sciatic nerve. Cramps in the muscles, in front of the leg while walking. Relationship — Compare: Astragalus Lamberti or Oxyt., a variety of Loco weed; also Bar-c. Dose — Sixth and two hundredth potencies.

(Silver) Arg-met.

Emaciation, a gradual drying up, desire for fresh air, dyspnea, sensation of expansion and left sided pains are characteristic. The chief action is centered on the articulations and their component elements, bones, cartilages, and ligaments. Exostosis. Here the small blood vessels, close or wither and carious affections result. The symptoms come on

insidiously, lingeringly, but progressively. The larynx is also a special center of action for this drug.

sections.title: Mind
sections.content: Hurried feeling; time passes slowly; melancholy.

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Dull paroxysmal neuralgia over the left side (migraine), gradually increasing and ceasing suddenly. Scalp very tender to touch. Vertigo, with an intoxicated feeling, on looking at running water. Head feels empty, hollow (brain fag).

sections.title: Eyes
sections.content: Eyelids red and thick (blepharitis). Pain between the left eye and frontal eminence.

sections.title: Nose
sections.content: Exhausting coryza with sneezing.

sections.title: Face
sections.content: Pain in the facial bones.

sections.title: Throat
sections.content: Raw, hawking, gray, jelly like mucus. Throat sore on coughing. Profuse and easy expectoration in the moming.

sections.title: Urinary
sections.content: Diuresis. Urine profuse, turbid with a sweet odor. Frequent micturition. Polyuria.

sections.title: Male
sections.content: Crushed pain in testicles. Seminal emissions, without excitement. Frequent micturition with buming. Female — Ovaries feel too large. Bearing down pain. Prolapse of uterus. Eroded, spongy cervix. Leucorrhea foul, excoriating. Palliative in, scirhus of uterus. Pain in the left ovary. Climacteric haemorrhage. Sore feeling throughout the abdomen; worse by jarring. Uterine disease with pain in joints and limbs. Respiratory — Hoarseness. Aphonia. Raw, sore feeling when coughing. Total loss of voice in professional singers. Larynx feels sore and raw (laryngitis). Easy expectoration, looks like boiled starch. Sensation of a raw spot near the supra-sternal fossa. Worse from use of voice. Cough on laughing. Hectic fever at noon. Must hem and hawk on reading aloud. Great weakness of the chest; worse on the left side. Alteration in timbre of voice. Pain in left lower nbs.

sections.title: Back
sections.content: Severe backache; must walk bent, with oppression of chest.

sections.title: Extremities
sections.content: Rheumatic affections of joints, especially elbow and knee. Legs weak and trembling, worse descending stairs. Involuntary contractions of, fingers, partial paralysis of forearm; writer's cramp. Swelling of ankles.
