intro: The weakness characteristic of all Potassium salts is seen especially in this, with a soft pulse, coldness, general depression and characteristic stitches, which may be felt in any part of the body, or in connection with any affection. All Kali pains are sharp and cutting; nearly all are better by motion. Never use any salts of Potash when there is fever (T. F. Allen). Sensitive to every atmospheric change and intolerance of cold weather. One of the best remedies following labor. Miscarriage, for consequent debilitated states. Early moming aggravation is very characteristic. Fleshy, aged people with dropsical and paretic tendencies. Sweat, backache, and weakness. Throbbing pains. Tendency to dropsy. Tuber- cular diathesis. Pain from within out, and of a stinging character. “Giving- out” sensation. Fatty degenerations. Stinging pain in the muscles and intemal parts. Twitching of muscles. Pain in a small spot on the left side. Hypothyroidism. Coxitis.

sections.title: Mind
sections.content: Despondent. Alternating moods. Very irritable. Full of fear and imaginations. Anxiety felt in the stomach. Sensation as if the bed was sinking. Never wants to be left alone. Never quiet or contented. Obstinate and hypersensitive to pain, noise, touch. K 358 Kalium carbonicum

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Vertigo on tuming. Headache from riding in the cold wind. Headache comes on with yawning. Stitches in the temples; aching in the occiput, one sided, with nausea (migraine), on riding in a carriage. Loose feeling in the head. Great dryness of hair; falls out (Fl-ac.).

sections.title: Eyes
sections.content: Stitches in the eyes. Spots, gauze and black points before the eyes. Lids stick together in the moming. Swelling over the upper lid, like little bags. Swelling of glabella between the brows. Asthenopia. Weak sight from excessive sexual indulgence. On shutting eyes, painful sensation as if light penetrating the brain.

sections.title: Ears
sections.content: Stitches in the ears. Itching, cracking, ringing and roaring,

sections.title: Nose
sections.content: Nose stuffs up in a warm room. Thick, fluent, yellow discharge. Post-nasal dropping (Spig.). Sore, scurfy nostrils; bloody nasal mucus. Crusty nasal openings. Epistaxis on washing the face in the moming. Ulcerated nostrils.

sections.title: Mouth
sections.content: Gums separate from teeth; pus oozes out. Pyorrhea. Aphthae. Tongue white. Profuse saliva, constantly in the mouth. Bad, slimy iaste.

sections.title: Throat
sections.content: Dry, parched, rough. Sticking pain, as from a fish bone. Dysphagia; food goes down the oesophagus slowly. Mucous accumulates in the moming.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Flatulence. Desire for sweets. Sensation of a lump in the pit of the stomach. Gagging. Dyspepsia in old people; buming acidity, bloating. Gastric disorders from ice water. Sour eructations. Nausea; better lying down. Constant feeling, as if the stomach was full of water. Sour vomiting; throbbing and cutting pain in the stomach. Disgust for food. Anxiety felt in the stomach. Epigastrium, sensitive externally. Easy choking when eating. Epigastric pain radiates to the back.

sections.title: Abdomen
sections.content: Stitches in the region of liver. Old chronic liver problems, with soreness. Jaundice and dropsy. Distention and coldness of the abdomen. Pain from the left hypochondnum through the abdomen; must tum on the right side before he can rise.

sections.title: Rectum
sections.content: Large, difficult stools with stitching pain an hour before. Haemorrhoids, large, swollen, painful. Itching, ulcerated pimples around the anus. Large quantity of blood discharged with natural stool. Pain in the haemorrhoids when coughing. Buming in the rectum and anus. Easy prolapse (Graph.; Podo.}. Itching (Ign.).

sections.title: Urinary
sections.content: Obliged to rise several times at night to micturate. Kalium carbonicum 359 K Pressure in the bladder long before urine comes. Involuntary micturition when coughing, sneezing, etc.

sections.title: Male
sections.content: Complaints from coition. Deficient sexual instinct. Excessive emissions, followed by weakness.

sections.title: Female
sections.content: Menses early, profuse (Calc.), or too late, pale and scanty, with soreness around the genitals; pain from the back passes down, through the gluteal muscles, with cutting in the abdomen. Pain through the left labium, extending through the abdomen to the chest. Delayed menses in young girls with chest symptoms (hydrothorax) or ascites. Difficult, first menses. Complaints after parturition. Uterine haemorrhage; constant oozing after copious flow, with violent backache (dysmenor- thea), relieved by sitting and pressure.

sections.title: Respiratory
sections.content: Cutting pain in the chest; worse lying on the right side. Hoarseness and aphonia. Dry, hard cough around 3 a. m., with stitching pains and dryness of the pharynx. Bronchitis, the entire chest is very sensitive. Expectoration scanty and tenacious, but increasing in the moming and after eating; aggravated in the right lower chest and by lying on the painful side. Hydrothorax. Leaning forward relieves chest symptoms. Expectoration must be swallowed; cheesy taste; copious, offensive, lump. Coldness of the chest. Wheezing (asthma). Cough with a relaxed uvula. Tendency to tuberculosis; and to take cold; better in a warm climate.

sections.title: Heart
sections.content: Sensation as if the heart was suspended. Palpitations and burning in the heart region. Weak, rapid pulse; intermits due to digestive disturbance. Threatened heart failure.

sections.title: Back
sections.content: Great exhaustion. Stitches in region of kidneys and right scapula. Lumbosacral region feels weak. Stiffness and paralytic feeling in the back. Buming in the spine (Gua.). Severe backache during pregnancy, and after miscarriage. Hip disease. Pain in the nates, thighs and hip joint. Lumbago with sudden sharp pains extending up and down the back and extending to the thighs.

sections.title: Extremities
sections.content: Back and legs give out. Uneasiness, heaviness, and tearing in the limbs and jerking. Tearing pain in the limbs with swelling (sciatica). Limbs sensitive to pressure. White swelling of knee. Tearing in arms from the shoulder to the wrist. Lacerating pain in the wrist joint. Paralysis in old people, and dropsical affections. Limbs go to sleep easily. Tips oi wes and fingers painful. Soles very sensitive. Itching in the great toe, with pain (gout). Pain from the hip to the knee. Pain in the knees (arthritis). K 360 Kalium carbonicum @ Kalium chloricum

sections.title: Sleep
sections.content: Drowsy after eating. Wakes up around 2 o' clock and cannot sleep again.

sections.title: Skin
sections.content: Buming as from a mustard plaster. Modalities —- Worse, after coition; in cold weather; from soup and coffee; in the moming around three o’clock; lying on the left and painful side. Better, in warm weather, though moist; during the day, while moving around. Relationship — Complementary: Carb-v.; (lowness of vitality may suggest a preliminary course of Carb-v. to nurse up recuperation to the point that Kali-c. would come in helpfully). Follows Nux-v. often in stomach and bladder problems. Compare: Kalium salicylicum (vomiting, especially of pregnancy; arteriosclerosis, with chronic rheumatism); Kalium silicicum (gouty no- dosities); Kalium aceticum (diabetes, diarrhea, dropsy, alkaline urine, very much increased in quantity); Kalium citricum (Bright's disease—1 gr. to a wine glass of water); Kalium ferrocyanatum—Prussian blue (physical and mental prostration following infection. Inability to sustaine routine work. Neuralgic affections depending on impoverished blood supply and exhausted nerve centers, especially spinal. Fatty and functional heart problems. Pulse weak, small, imegular. Uterine symptoms, like Sep. bearing down sensation and gastric sinking; profuse, pus like leucorrhea and passive haemorrhage; use 6x); Kalium oxalicum (lumbago, convul- sions); Kalium picro-nitricum and Kalium picricum (jaundice, violent eructations); Kalium tartaricum (paraplegia); Kalium telluricum (garlicky odor of breath, salivation, swollen tongue). sections.title: Dose
sections.content: Thirtieth and higher. Sixth trituration. Do not repeat too often. Use cautiously in old gouty cases, advanced Bright's disease and tuberculosis.

name: Kalium       Chloricum
author: Boericke
dose: Second to sixth potency.      Use cautiously, locally as it is poisonous.
intro:
(Chlorate of Potassium—K clo. 3) Kali-chl.

Acts very destructively upon the kidneys, producing croupous nephritis, haemoglobinuria, etc. Parenchymatous nephritis with stoma- titis. Produces acute ulcerative and follicular stomatitis. Noma. Toxemic conditions of pregnancy (urinary symptoms). Chronic nephritis; hepatitis. Septicemia. Anaemia. Kalium chloricum e Kalium cyanatum e Kalium hydriodicum 361 K

sections.title: Mouth
sections.content: Profuse secretion of acrid saliva. Entire mucous membrane red, tumid, with gray based ulcers. Tongue swollen (glossitis). Stoma- titis—aphthous and gangrenous. Fetor. Mercurial stomatitis (as a mouth wash).

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Sensation of weight in the epigastric and umbilical region. Flatulence. Vomiting of greenish-black matter (haematemesis).

sections.title: Rectum
sections.content: Diarrhea; profuse with greenish mucus.

sections.title: Urinary
sections.content: Albuminous, scanty, suppressed. Haematuria: diuresis.

sections.title: Nucleo
sections.content: albumin and bile, high phosphoric acid, with low total solids.

sections.title: Skin
sections.content: Jaundice. Itching miliary or papular eruptions. Discoloured; chocolate tint.

sections.title: Dose
sections.content: Second to sixth potency.      Use cautiously, locally as it is poisonous.

name: Kalium Hydriodicum
author: Boericke
modalities: Worse, warm clothing, warm room, at night, damp weather. Better, motion, open air.
relationships: Antidote: Hep. Compare: Jod.; Merc.; Sulph.; Mez. Chopheenee, a Hindu remedy for syphilitic eruptions, ulcerations and bone pains. Used in tincture.
dose: Crude drug in material officinal dosage, but remember Dr. Meyhoffer’s statements in his chronic diseases of organs of respiration: “From the moment the drug produces pathogenetic symptoms, it exag- gerates the function of the tissue, exhausts the already diminished vitality and thence, instead of stimulating the organic cell in the direction of life, impairs or abolishes its power of contraction. We use, as a rule, the first dilution, 6 to 20 drops a day; if after a week no decided progress is visible, one drop of the tincture of Jod. is added to each hundred of the first dilution. In this way, the mucous tubercles, gummy deposits and ulcerations resulting therefrom in the larynx undergo a favorable termi- nation in laryngeal syphilis.” When strictly homoeopathically indicated, as in acute respiratory affections the third potency is indicated.
intro:
The profuse, watery, acrid coryza that the drug produces, serves as a sure guiding symptom, especially when associated with pain in the frontal sinus. It acts predominantly on the fibrous and connective tissues,

H. M. M. - 15 K 362 Kalium hydriodicum

producing infiltration. oedema, etc. Glandular swellings. Purpura and haemorrhagic diathesis. Syphilis may be indicated in all stages: 1. In acute form with evening remitting fever, going off with noctumal perspiration. 2. Second stage, mucous membranes and skin ulcerates. 3. Tertiary symptoms; nodes. Give material doses. Diffused sensitiveness (glands, scalp, etc.). Rheumatism of the neck, back, feet, especially heels and soles; worse, cold and wet. Kali-i. in material doses acts in different forms of fungal diseases (thrush, rngwom, etc.), often simulating syphilis and bacterial diseases like tuberculosis. Symptoms like loss of weight, haemoptysis, etc. Tea tasters cough after inhaling the fungus; often brings about a favorable reaction in many chronic ailments even when not clearly, symptomatically indicated. Mind — Sad, anxious; harsh temper. Imtable; congestion of the head, heat and throbbing. Head — Pain through the sides of head. Violent headache. Cranium swells up in a hard lump. Pain intense over the eyes and at the root of nose. Brain feels enlarged. Hard nodes, with severe pain; pneumo- coccic meningitis. Eyes — Conjunctiva red, injected; profuse lachrymation (conjunc- tivitis). Syphilitic witis. Pustular keratitis and chemosis. Bony tumors of the orbit. Ears — Noises in the ear (tinnitus). Boring pain in the ears (otalgia). Nose — Red, swollen. Tip of the nose red; profuse, acrid, hot, watery, thin discharge. Ozaena, with a perforated septum. Sneezing. Nasal catarrh, involving the frontal sinus. Stuffiness and dryness in the nose, without discharge. Profuse, cool, greenish, non-imtating dis- charges.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Saliva increased. Faintness in the epigastrium. Cold food and drink, especially milk, aggravate. Marked thirst. Throbbing, painful, buming. Flatulence.

sections.title: Female
sections.content: Menses late, profuse. During menses uterus feels as if squeezed. Corrosive leucorrhea, with subacute inflammatory conditions of the womb in young married women. Fibroid tumors, metritis, sub- involution, hypertrophy, 1x or 1 gr. crude, 3 times a day.

sections.title: Respiratory
sections.content: Violent cough; worse in the moming. Pulmonary oedema. Larynx feels raw. Laryngeal oedema. Wakes up due to choking. Expectoration like soap suds, greenish. Pneumonia, when hepatization commences. Stitching pains through the lungs extending to the back. Kalium hydriodicum e Kalium muriaticum 363 K Asthma. Dyspnea on ascending, with pain in the heart. Hydrothorax (Merc-sul.). Pleuritic effusion. Cold travels downwards to the chest.

sections.title: Extremities

Formication in the lower extremities when sitting, better lying down.

sections.title: Skin
sections.content: Purple spots (petechae); worse on the legs (erythema nodosum). Acne, hydroa. Small boils. Glands enlarged, indurated. Hives. name: Kalium Permanganicum
author: Boericke
dose: Locally, 1 dram in a quart of water, to correct fetor in cancer, ulcer, ozaena and other foul odors. Also as an injection in leucorrhea and gonorrhea. Internally, 2x dilution in water. Saturated solution locally in eruption of smallpox. Potassium permanganate for morphine poisoning — Potassium permanganate is recognized as being the most effective chemical antidote in cases of morphine or opium poisoning, acting directly on the morphine and oxidizing it to less toxic substances. To be effective, the perman- ganate must come in direct contact with the opium or morphine in the stomach; hypodermic or intravenous injections are absolutely useless, as the salt willbe decomposed by the blood serum at once. The approved treatment is administration of two to five grains of potassium perman- ganate in dilute aqueous solution as soon as possible after the poison is taken, this amount is to be increased if very large doses of the poison have been taken. Washing out the stomach with a quantity of 1 to 500 solution of permanganate is also recommended, using at least a pint of this solution either by a stomach pump or by enforced vomiting. Permang. of Potash counteracts the effects of alkaloids of many poisonous plants. Owing to its oxidizing powers, if given before the alkaloid has been absorbed (Dr. Chestnut in Dept. of Agriculture).

intro: A rheumatic remedy. Pains shift rapidly. Nausea and slow pulse frequently accompanying. Also has a prominent action on the heart. In small doses, it accelerates the heart's action; in larger, it moderates it greatly. Neuralgia; pains shoot downward, with numbness. Fulgurating - pains of locomotor ataxia. Protracted and continuous fevers, with tympanites. Paralytic sensations; pain and aching in the limbs accom- pany nearly every group of symptoms. Albuminuria.

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Vertigo; worse stooping. Confusion of brain. Pain in front and temporal region from the head to the nape and to the teeth; from cardiac origin.

sections.title: Eyes
sections.content: Vision impaired. Stiff, drawing sensation on moving the eyes. Rheumatic iritis. Scleritis, pain increased by moving the eye.

sections.title: Face
sections.content: Neuralgia; worse right side. Stitches in the tongue. Stitches and tearing in the bones of jaw and face.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Warm, glowing sensation in the epigastrium. Nausea; vomiting. Pain in the pit of the stomach; worse bending forward; relieved by sitting erect. Bilious attacks with nausea, vertigo and headache. Sensation of something being pressed under the epigastrium.

sections.title: Urinary
sections.content: Frequent, with sharp pains in the lumbar region. Post- scarlatinal nephritis.

sections.title: Female
sections.content: Menses too early, or suppressed, with pain in the limbs, back and inside of thighs. Leucorrhea follows menses.

sections.title: Heart
sections.content: Weak, slow pulse (Dig.; Apoc.). Fluttering of heart with anxiety. Palpitations; worse leaning forward. Gouty and rheumatic metastasis of the heart. Shooting through the chest, K 372 Kalmia latifolia e Kola above the heart, into the shoulder blades. Frequent pulse. Heart's action tumultuous, rapid and visible. Paroxysms of anguish around the heart.

sections.title: Back
sections.content: Pain from the neck radiates down the arm (cervical spondylosis); in the upper three dorsal vertebrae extending to the shoulder blade. Pain down the back, as if it would break (lumbago); in localized regions of the spine: through the shoulders. Lumbar pain, of nervous origin.

Sleep — Sleepless, wakes up very early in the morning.

intro: Kreosotum is a mixture of phenols obtained from its distillation. Pulsations all over the body and profuse bleeding from small wounds. Very severe, old, neuralgic affections; pain aggravated by rest. Excoriating, buming and offensive discharges. Haemorrhages, ulcer- ations, cancerous affections. Rapid decomposition of fluids and secre- tions; buming pains. Overgrown, poorly developed children. Post- climacteric diseases. Tumefaction, puffiness, gangrene. Aliments in teething children.

sections.title: Mind
sections.content: Music causes weeping and palpitations. Vanishing of thought; stupid, forgetful, peevish, imitable. Child wants everything but throws it away when given.

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Dull pain, as if a board was pressing against the forehead. Menstrual headache. Occipital pain (Gels.; Zinc-pic.).

sections.title: Eyes
sections.content: Salty lachrymation. Lids red and swollen (blepharitis).

sections.title: Ears
sections.content: Eruption around and pimples within.    Difficult hearing and buzzing (tinnitus). K 374 ; Kreosotum

sections.title: Nose
sections.content: Offensive smell and discharge (ozaena).        Chronic catarrh in old people. Acrid rawness. Lupus (Ars.).

sections.title: Face
sections.content: Sick, suffering expression; cheeks red, hot.

sections.title: Mouth
sections.content: Lips red, bleeding. Very painful dentition; child will not sleep. Very rapid decay of teeth (caries), with spongy, bleeding gums (scorbutic); teeth dark and crumbly (Staph.; Ant-c.). Putrid odor and bitter taste.

sections.title: Throat
sections.content: Buming, choking sensation. Putrid odor.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Nausea; vomiting of food several hours after eating; of sweetish water in the moming. Sensation of coldness, as if ice water is inthe stomach. Soreness; better eating. Painful hard spot. Haematemesis. Bitter taste after a mouthful of water.

sections.title: Abdomen
sections.content: Distended. Buming haemorthoids. Diarrhea; very offensive; dark brown. Bloody, fetid stools. Cholera infantum in connection with painful dentition, green stools, nausea, dry skin, exhaustion, etc.

sections.title: Urinary
sections.content: Offensive. Violent itching in vulva and vagina, worse when micturating. Can micturate only when lying; cannot get out of bed fast enough during first sleep. Dreams of micturating. Enuresis in the first part of night. Must hurry when desire comes to micturate.

sections.title: Female
sections.content: Corrosive pruritis vulva, buming and swelling of the labia; violent itching between labia and thighs. During menses, difficult hearing; buzzing and roaring; eruptions afterwards. Buming and soreness in the external and intemal parts. Leucorthea, yellow, acrid; odor of green com; worse between periods. Haemorrhage after coition. Menses too early, prolonged (metrorrhagia). Vomiting of pregnancy, with ptyalism. Menstrual flow intermits (Puls.); ceases on sitting or walking; reappears on lying down. Pain worse after menses. Lochia offensive; intermits.

sections.title: Respiratory
sections.content: Hoarse, with pain in the larynx. Cough; ~worse evening with retching and pain in the chest. Raw buming in the chest; pain and oppression. Cough after influenza (Erio.). Winter coughs in old people, with heavy pressure on the sternum. Gangrene of the lungs. After every cough, copious, purulent expectoration. Haemoptysis; periodic attacks (phthisis). Sternum feels pressed in.

sections.title: Back
sections.content: Dragging backache, extending to the genitals and down the thighs. Great debility. Kreosotum @ Lac caninum Sy acie& -Extremities — Pain in joints, hip and knee. Boring pain in the hip joints. Scapulae sore.

sections.title: Sleep
sections.content: Disturbed with tossing. Paralytic sensation in the limbs on waking. Anxious dreams of pursuit, fire, erections, etc.

sections.title: Skin
sections.content: Itching, worse towards the evening. Buming in the soles. Senile gangrene. Small wounds bleed freely (Crot-h.; Lach.; Phos.). Pustules and herpes. Ecchymosis (purpura); dorsal surface of fingers and hands eczematous.

author: Boericke
modalities: Worse, moming of one day and in the evening of next. Better, cold, cold drinks.
relationships: Compare: Lach.; Con.; Lac felinum—Cat's Milk (ciliary neuralgia; eye symptoms, photophobia; asthenopia; dysmenor- thea); Lac vaccinum—Cows’ Milk (headache, rheumatic pains, constipa- tion); Lac vaccinum coagulatum—Curds (nausea of pregnancy); Lactis vaccini flos—Cream (diphtheria, leucorrhea, menorthagia, dysphagia);
dose: Thirtieth and the highest potencies. Lac defloratum e Lachesis mutus SL ke
intro: This remedy is of undoubted value in certain forms of sore throat, diphtheria and rheumatism. Corresponds to a low vitiated, non-feverish type of sickness. The keynote symptom is, erratic pains, alternating sides. Feels as if walking on air, or of not touching the bed when lying down. Great lassitude. Ozaena. Decided effect in drying up milk in women who cannot nurse the baby. Great weakness and prostration. Sinking spells every moming. Mastitis.

sections.title: Mind
sections.content: Very forgetful while wmiting, makes mistakes. Despondent; thinks her disease is incurable. Attacks of rage. Visions of snakes. Thinks himself to be of little consequence.

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Sensation of walking or floating in air (Stict.). Pain first on one side, then on the other. Blurred vision, nausea and vomiting at the height of an attack of headache (migraine). Shooting pain in the occiput L 376 Lac caninum extending to the forehead. Sensation as if the brain was alternately contracted and relaxed.

sections.title: Ears
sections.content: Reverberation of voice. Noises in ears.

sections.title: Nose
sections.content: Coryza; one nostril is stuffed up, the other free; alternate. Alae nasi and comers of the mouth cracked. Bones of the nose sore to pressure. Bloody pus discharged (ozaena).

sections.title: Mouth
sections.content: Tongue coated white with bright red edges; profuse salivation. Drooling in diphtheria. Cracking of jaw while eating (Nit- ac.; Rhus-t.). Putrid taste increased by sweets.

sections.title: Throat
sections.content: Sensitive to touch. Painful swallowing; pain extends to the ears. Sore throat and cough with menstruation. Tonsillitis and diphtheria symptoms change repeatedly from _ side to side. Shining glazed appearance of deposits, pearly white or like pure white porcelain. Stiffness of the neck and tongue. Throat feels bumed, raw. Tickling sensation causes constant cough. Sore throat beginning and ending with menses.

sections.title: Female
sections.content: Menses too early, profuse, flow in gushes. Breasts swollen; painful before (Calc.; Con.; Puls.) and better on appearance of menses. Mastitis; worse, least jar. Helps to dry up milk. Sinking in the epigastrium. Sexual organs easily excited. Backache; spine very sensitive to touch or pressure. Galactorrhea.

sections.title: Extremities
sections.content: Sciatica, right side. Legs feel numb and stiff, cram > in feet. Rheumatic pains in the extremities and back, from one side to the other. Pain in the arms extending to the finger. Buming in palms and soles.

sections.title: Sleep
sections.content: Dreams of snakes.

sections.title: Modalities

full:
Dog’s Milk
This remedy is of undoubted value in certain forms of sore throat, diphtheria and rheumatism. Corresponds to a low vitiated, non-feverish type of sickness. The keynote symptom is, erratic pains, alternating sides. Feels as if walking on air, or of not touching the bed when lying down. Great lassitude. Ozaena. Decided effect in drying up milk in women who cannot nurse the baby. Great weakness and prostration. Sinking spells every moming. Mastitis.
Mind — Very forgetful while wmiting, makes mistakes. Despondent; thinks her disease is incurable. Attacks of rage. Visions of snakes. Thinks himself to be of little consequence.
Head — Sensation of walking or floating in air (Stict.). Pain first on one side, then on the other. Blurred vision, nausea and vomiting at the height of an attack of headache (migraine). Shooting pain in the occiput L 376 Lac caninum extending to the forehead. Sensation as if the brain was alternately contracted and relaxed.
Ears — Reverberation of voice. Noises in ears.
Nose — Coryza; one nostril is stuffed up, the other free; alternate. Alae nasi and comers of the mouth cracked. Bones of the nose sore to pressure. Bloody pus discharged (ozaena).
Mouth — Tongue coated white with bright red edges; profuse salivation. Drooling in diphtheria. Cracking of jaw while eating (Nit- ac.; Rhus-t.). Putrid taste increased by sweets.
Throat — Sensitive to touch. Painful swallowing; pain extends to the ears. Sore throat and cough with menstruation. Tonsillitis and diphtheria symptoms change repeatedly from _ side to side. Shining glazed appearance of deposits, pearly white or like pure white porcelain. Stiffness of the neck and tongue. Throat feels bumed, raw. Tickling sensation causes constant cough. Sore throat beginning and ending with menses.
Female — Menses too early, profuse, flow in gushes. Breasts swollen; painful before (Calc.; Con.; Puls.) and better on appearance of menses. Mastitis; worse, least jar. Helps to dry up milk. Sinking in the epigastrium. Sexual organs easily excited. Backache; spine very sensitive to touch or pressure. Galactorrhea.
Extremities — Sciatica, right side. Legs feel numb and stiff, cram > in feet. Rheumatic pains in the extremities and back, from one side to the other. Pain in the arms extending to the finger. Buming in palms and soles.
Sleep — Dreams of snakes.
Modalities — Worse, moming of one day and in the evening of next. Better, cold, cold drinks.

sections.title: Mind
sections.content: Great loquacity. Amative. Sad in the moming; no desire to mix with the world. Restless and uneasy; does not wish to attend to business; wants to be off somewhere all the time. Jealous (Hyos.). Mental labour best performed at night. Euthanasia. Suspicious; nocturnal delusion of fire. Religious insanity (Verat.; Stram.). Derangement of time sense.

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Pain through the head on awaking. Pain at the root of the nose. Pressure and-buming in the vertex. Waves of pain; worse after moving. Sun headaches, with headache, flickerings, dim vision, very pale face (apoplexy). Vertigo (Meniere's disease). Relieved by the onset of a discharge (menses or nasal catarrh). L378 Lachesis mutus K

sections.title: Eyes
sections.content: Defective vision after diphtheria, extrinsic muscles too weak to maintain focus. Sensation as if the eyes were drawn together by cords which were tied in a knot at the root of the nose.

sections.title: Ears
sections.content: Tearing pains from the zygoma into the ear; with a sore throat. Cerumen hard, dry.

sections.title: Nose
sections.content: Epistaxis, nostrils sensitive. Coryza, preceded by headache. Hay asthma; paroxysms of sneezing (Sil.; Sabad.).

sections.title: Face
sections.content: Pale. Trigeminal neuralgia, left side, heat running up to the head (Phos.). Tearing pains in the jaw bones (Amph.; Phos.). Purple, mottled, puffed; looks swollen, bloated, jaundiced, chlorotic.

sections.title: Mouth
sections.content: Gums swollen, spongy, bleed (scorbutic). Tongue swollen, bums, trembles, red, dry and cracked at the tip, catches in between teeth (glossitis). Aphthous and denuded spots with buming and rawness. Nauseous taste. Toothache, pain extends to the ears. Pain in the facial bones.

sections.title: Throat
sections.content: Sore, worse left side, swallowing liquids. Quinsy. Septic parotiditis. Dry, intensely swollen, extemally and intemally. Diphthena; membrane dusky, blackish; pain aggravated by hot drinks; chronic sore throat, with much hawking; mucus sticks, and cannot be forced up or down. Very painful; worse slightest pressure, touch is even more annoying. In diphtheria, etc., the trouble begins on the left side. Tonsils purplish. Purple, livid colour of the throat. Sensation as if something was swollen which must be swallowed; worse, swallowing saliva or liquids. Pain radiates to the ear. Collar and neck band must be very loose. Empty swallowing more painful than swallowing solids.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Craving for alcohol, oysters. Any food causes distress. Pit of the stomach painful to touch. Hungry, cannot wait for food. Gnawing pressure, better by eating (gastric ulcers}, but returning in a few hours. Perceptible trembling movement in the epigastric region.

sections.title: Abdomen
sections.content: Liver region sensitive, cannot bear anything around the waist (jaundice). Especially suitable to drunkards. Abdomen tympa- nitic, sensitive, painful (Bell.).

sections.title: Rectum
sections.content: Constipated, offensive stool. Anus feels tight as if nothing could go through it. Pain darting up the rectum every time he sneezes or coughs. Haemorrhage from the bowels like charred straw, black particles. Haemorrhoids protrude, become constricted, purplish. Stitches in them on sneezing or coughing. Constant urging in the rectum, not for stool.

sections.title: Male
sections.content: Intense excitement of sexual organs. Lachesis mutus 379 L

sections.title: Female
sections.content: Climacteric problems, palpitations, flashes of heat, haemorrhages, headache in the vertex, fainting spells; worse, pressure of clothes. Menses too short, too feeble; pains, all relieved by the flow (Eupi). Left ovary very painful and swollen, indurated. _Mammae inflamed, bluish (mastitis). Coccyx and sacrum painful, especially on rising from a sitting posture. Acts especially well at the beginning and close of menstruation.

sections.title: Respiratory
sections.content: Upper part of the trachea is very susceptible to touch. Sensation of suffocation and strangulation on lying down oedema of the lungs, particularly when anything is around the throat; compels the patient to spring from the bed and mush for an open window. Spasms of the glottis (laryngismus); feels as if something ran down, from the neck to the larynx. Feels he must take a deep breath. Cramp like distress in the praecordial region. Cough; dry, suffocative fits, tickling (asthma). Little secretion and much sensitiveness; worse, pressure on the larynx, after sleep, open air. Breathing almost stops on falling asleep (Grin.). Larynx painful to touch. Sensation of a plug (Anac.) which moves up and down, with a short cough.

sections.title: Heart
sections.content: Palpitations, with fainting spells, especially during climac- teric. Constricted feeling causing palpitations with anxiety. Cyanosis. Irregular beats.

sections.title: Back
sections.content: Neuralgia of the coccyx worse rising from a sitting posture; must sit perfectly still. Pain in the neck, worse cervical region (cervical spondylitis). Sensation of threads stretched from the back to the arms, legs, eyes, etc.

sections.title: Extremities
sections.content: Sciatica, right side, better lying down.    Pain in the tibia (may follow sore throat). Shortening of tendons.

sections.title: Sleep
sections.content: Patient sleeps into an aggravation. Sudden starting on falling asleep. Sleepiness, yet cannot sleep (Bell.; Op.). Wide awake in the evening.

sections.title: Fever
sections.content: Chills in the back; feet icy cold; hot flushes and hot perspiration. Paroxysm retums after acids. Intermittent fever every spring.

sections.title: Skin

Blue-black swellings (ecchymosis). Pyemia; dissecting wounds. Purpura with intense prostration. Senile erysipelas. Wens. Cellulitis. Varicose ulcers.

name: Linum Usitatissimum
author: Boericke
relationships: Compare: Linum catharticum—Purging flax (similar respiratory symptoms, but also colic and diarrhea).
intro: The application of Linseed poultice has produced in sensitive subjects, severe respiratory disturbances, such as asthma, hives, etc. Its action in such cases is marked by intense irritation. It has been found to contain a small quantity of Hydrocyanic acid, which may account for this intensity. The decoction is of service in inflammation of the urinary passages, cystitis, strangury, etc. Also in diseases of the intestinal tract. It has a place in the treatment of asthma, hay fever and urticaria. Trismus and paralysis of the tongue. Lithium carbonicum 393 L

name: Lithium Carbonicum
author: Boericke
intro: Chronic rheumatism connected with heart lesions and asthenopia- offer a field for this remedy. Rheumatic nodes. Uric acid diathesis. The whole body is sore. Gout and tophi.

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Tension, as if bound; better, sitting and going out. Externally sensitive. Headache ceases while eating. Trembling and throbbing. Pain in the heart; extends to the head. Dizzy states with ringing in the ears (Meniere's disease). Both cheeks covered with dry, bran like scales.

sections.title: Eyes
sections.content: Half vision (hemiopia); invisible night half. Photophobia. Pain over the eyes. Dry lids. Eyes pain after reading (aesthenopia).

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Acidity, nausea, gnawing, relieved by eating (Anac.). Cannot endure the slightest pressure, even of clothes (Lach.).

sections.title: Urinary
sections.content: Tenesmus. Turbid urine with mucus and red deposits. Pain in the region of the nght kidney and ureter. Free and colourless. While micturating, pressure in the heart. Cystitis, subacute and chronic. Soreness of the bladder. Urine scanty and dark, acrid; sandy deposit (albuminuria).

sections.title: Respiratory
sections.content: Constriction of the chest. Violent cough when lying down. Air feels cold when inspired. Pain in the mammary glands, which extends into the arms and fingers.

sections.title: Heart
sections.content: Rheumatic soreness in the cardiac region. Sudden shocks in the heart (angina pectoris). Throbbing, dull stitch in the cardiac region. Pain in the heart before menses, associated with pain in the bladder, before micturition; better, after. Trembling and fluttering in the heart, extending to the back.

sections.title: Extremities
sections.content: Paralytic stiffness all over. Itching around the joints. Rheumatic pains throughout, the small joints are generally affected. Pain in the hollow of the foot, extending to the knee. Swelling and tendemess of finger and toe joints; better, hot water. Nodular swellings in joints. Ankles pain when walking.

sections.title: Skin
sections.content: Scabby, tettery eruption on the hands, head and cheeks, preceded by a red, raw skin. Dull stitch, ending in itching. Barber's itch H. M. M. - 16 L 394 Lithium carbonicum e@ Lobelia inflata K {use high). Rough rash all over the body, loose epithelium, tough, dry, itchy skin. Modalities — Worse, in the moming, right side. Better, rising and moving about. Relationship — Compare: Lyc.; Am-p.; Benz-ac.; Calc.; Lithium muriaticum (symptoms of cinchonism, viz.; dizzy head, full, blurring of vision. Ringing in the ears; marked tremors; general weakness; marked muscular and general prostration; no gastro-intestinal effects. Nose sore, heartbum, pain in teeth). Lithium lacticum (rheumatism of shoulder, and small joints relieved by moving about; worse, resting). Lithium benzoicum (deep seated pains in the loins; in lumbosacral region; uneasiness in the bladder. Cystitis. Gallstones. Frequent desire. Diminishing uric acid deposit) Lithium bromatum {cerebral congestion, threatened apoplexy, insomnia and epilepsy). Dose — First to third trituration.

intro:
This drug is inert until the spores are crushed. Its wonderful medicinal properties are only disclosed by trituration and succussion. Lycopodium clavatum 399 L

In nearly all the cases where Lyc. is indicated, evidence of urinary or digestive disturbance will be found. It corresponds to Grauvogle’s carbo-nitrogenoid constitution, the non-eliminative lithemic. Lyc. is especially adapted to ailments developing gradually, functional power weakens, failure of the digestive powers, when the liver function is seriously disturbed. Atony. Malnutrition. Mild temperaments of lymphatic constitution with catarrhal tendencies; older people, with an earthy complexion, uric acid diathesis, skin shows yellowish spots, etc.; also precocious, weak children. Symptoms characteristically run from right to left, acts especially on the right side of the body and are worse from about 4 to 8 p. m. In kidney affections, red sand in urine, backache in the renal region; worse before micturition. Intolerant of cold drinks; - craves everything warm. Best adapted to intellectually keen people, but of weak, muscular power. Deep seated, progressive, chronic diseases. Carcinoma. Emaciation. Debility in the moming. Marked regulating influence upon the glandular (sebaceous) secretions. Pre-senility. Ascites in liver disease. Lyc. patient is thin, withered, full of gas and dry. Lacks vital heat; has poor circulation, cold extremities. Pains come and go suddenly. Sensitive to noise and odors.

sections.title: Mind
sections.content: Melancholy; afraid to be alone. Little things annoy. Extremely sensitive. Averse to undertaking new things. Headstrong and haughty when sick. Loss of self confidence. Humied when eating. Constant fear of breaking down under stress. Apprehensive. Weak memory, confused thoughts; spells or writes wrong words and syllables. Failing brain power (Anac.; Phos.; Bar-c.). Cannot bear to see anything new. Cannot read what he wnites. Sadness in the moming on awaking.

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Shakes head without any apparent cause. Twists face and mouth. Pressing headache on the vertex; worse from 4 to 8 p. m. and from lying down or stooping, if not eating regularly (Cact.). Throbbing headache after every paroxysm of cough. Headaches over the eyes in severe colds; better, uncovering (Sulph.). Vertigo in the moming on rising. Pain in the temples, as if they were screwed together. Tearing pain in the occiput; better, fresh air. Severe hairfall. Eczema; moist oozing behind the ears. Deep furrows on the forehead. Premature baldness and gray hair.

sections.title: Eyes
sections.content: Styes on the lids near the inner canthus. Day blindness (hemeralopia) (Both.). Night blindness (nyctalopia) more characteristic. Sees only one-half of an object (hemiopia). Ulceration and redness of the lids (blepharitis). Eyes half open during sleep. L 400 Lycopodium clavatum

sections.title: Ears
sections.content: Thick, yellow, offensive discharge. Eczema around and behind the ears. Otorrhea and deafness with or without tinnitus; after scarlatina. Humming and roaring with hardness of hearing; every noise causes a peculiar echo in the ear.

sections.title: Nose
sections.content: Sense of smell very acute. Sensation of dryness posteriorly. Scanty, excoriating discharge anteriorly. Ulcerated nostrils. Crusts and elastic plugs (Kali-bi.; Teucr.). Fluent coryza. Nose stopped up. Snuffles; child starts from sleep rubbing nose. Fan like motion of alae nasi (Kali-br.; Phos.).

sections.title: Face
sections.content: Grayish-yellow discolouration of the face, with blue circles around the eyes. Withered, shrivelled and emaciated; copper coloured eruption. Dropping of lower jaw, in typhoid fever (Lach.; Op.). Itching; scaly herpes on the face and comer of mouth.

sections.title: Mouth
sections.content: Teeth excessively painful to touch. Toothache, with swelling of cheeks; relieved by warm application. Dryness of mouth and tongue, without thirst. Tongue dry, black, cracked, swollen; oscillates to and fro. Mouth waters. Blisters on the tongue. Halitosis

sections.title: Throat
sections.content: Dryness of the throat, without thirst. Food and drink regurgitates through the nose. Inflammation of the throat, with stitches on swallowing; better, warm drinks. Swelling and suppuration of tonsils. Ulceration of tonsils, beginning on the right side. Diphtheria; deposits spread from right to left; worse, cold drinks. Ulceration of vocal bands. Tubercular laryngitis, especially when ulceration commences.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Dyspepsia due to farinaceous and fermentable food, cabbage, beans, etc. Excessive hunger. Aversion to bread, etc. Desire for sweet things. Food tastes sour. Sour eructations. Great weakness of digestion. Bulimia, with much bloating. After eating, pressure in the stomach, with bitter taste in mouth. Eating ever so little creates fullness. Cannot eat oysters. Rolling of flatulence (Chin.; Carb-v.). Wakes up at night feeling hungry. Hiccough. Incomplete, burning eructations rise only up to the pharynx, where they burn for hours. Likes to take the hot food and drink. Sinking sensation; worse night. Abdomen — Immediately after a light meal, abdomen is bloated, full. Constant sense of fermentation in the abdomen, like yeast; upper left side. Hemia, right side. Liver sensitive. Brown spots on the abdomen. Dropsy, due to hepatic disease. Hepatitis, atrophic form of nutmeg liver. Pain shooting across the lower abdomen, from right to left.

sections.title: Rectum
sections.content: Diarrhea. Inactive intestinal canal.     Ineffectual urging. Lycopodium clavatum 401 L Stool hard, difficult, small, incomplete. Haemorrhoids; very painful to touch, aching (Mur-ac.).

sections.title: Urinary
sections.content: Pain in the back before micturating; ceases after flow; slow in coming, must strain. Retention. Polyuria at night. Heavy red sediment. Child cries before micturating (Borx.).

sections.title: Male
sections.content: No erectile power; impotence. Premature emission (Calad.; Sel.; Agn.). Enlarged prostate. Condylomata.

sections.title: Female
sections.content: Menses too late; last too long, too profuse. Vagina dry. Coition painful. Pain in the right ovarian region. Varicose veins of pudenda. Leucorrhea, acrid, with buming in the vagina. Discharge of blood from genitals during stool.

sections.title: Respiratory
sections.content: Tickling cough. Dyspnea. Tensive, constrictive, buming pain in the chest. Cough worse going down hill. Cough deep, hollow (whooping cough). Expectoration gray, thick, bloody, purulent, salty (Ars.; Phos.; Puls.). Nocturnal cough, tickling as from sulphur fumes. Catarrh of the chest in infants, seems full of mucus, rattling. Neglected pneumonia with great dyspnea, flaying of alae nasi and presence of mucous rales.

sections.title: Heart
sections.content: Aneurism (Bar-c.). Aortic disease. Palpitations at night. Cannot lie on the left side.

sections.title: Back
sections.content: Burning between scapulae as if from hot coals. Pain in the small of back (lumbosacral region).

sections.title: Extremities

Chronic gout, with chalky deposits in the joints. Profuse foot sweat. Pain:in the heels on treading, as if from a pebble. Painful callosities (coms) on the soles; toes and fingers contracted. Twitching and jerking (locomotor ataxia).

sections.title: Sleep
sections.content: Drowsy during the day. Starting in sleep. Dreams of accidents.

sections.title: Fever

sections.title: Skin

Sciatica, worse right side. Cannot lie on the painful side. Hands and feet numb. Right foot hot, left cold. Cramps in calves and toes at night in bed. Limbs go to sleep. Twitching and jerking (locomotor ataxia).
Sleep — Drowsy during the day. Starting in sleep. Dreams of accidents.
Fever — Chill between 3 and 4 p. m., followed by sweat. Icy coldness. Feels as if lying on ice. One chill is followed by another (Calc.; Sil; Hep.).

Chronic eczema associated with urinary, gastric and hepatic disorders; bleeds easily. Skin becomes thick and indurated. Varicose veins, nevi, erectile tumors. Brown spots, freckles worse on left side of face and nose. Dry shrunken, especially palms; hair becomes prematurely gray. Dropsies. Offensive secretions; viscid and offensive perspiration, especially of feet and axilla. Psoriasis.

(day blindness: can scarcely see after sunrise; pain in the right great toe (gout). sections.title: Head
sections.content: Sticking pain in the side of the head on which he lies, as if the hair was pulled; worse, mental exertion. Itching of scalp worse in damp weather. Pain above the margin of right orbit. Black motes before the eyes.

sections.title: Ears
sections.content: Diminished hearing. Deafness; comes suddenly and varies. Numbness of the outer ear. Feeling of distention in the middle ear. Subdued tinnitus. Magnesia carbonica 405 M

sections.title: Face
sections.content: Tearing pain on one side; worse, quiet; must move about. Toothache, especially during pregnancy; worse at night; worse, cold and quiet. Teeth feel too long. Ailments from cutting wisdom teeth (Cheir.). Pain in the malar bone, worse during rest, night. Swelling of the malar bone with pulsating pain, worse exposure to cold wind.

sections.title: Mouth
sections.content: Dry at night. Sour taste. Vesicular eruption; bloody saliva. Sticking pain in the throat; hawking up of fetid, pea coloured particles.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Desire for fruit, acids and vegetables. Eructations sour, and vomiting of bitter water. Craving for meat.

sections.title: Abdomen
sections.content: Rumbling, gurgling. Dragging towards the pelvis. Very heavy; contractive, pinching pains in the right iliac region.

sections.title: Stool
sections.content: Preceded by gripping, colicky pain. Green, watery, frothy, like a frog pond’s scum. Bloody mucous with stools (dysentery). Milk passes undigested in nursing children. Sour, with tenesmus (Rheum). Constipation after mental shock or severe nervous strain.

sections.title: Female

sections.title: Respiratory

sections.title: Extremities

sections.title: Sleep

sections.title: Fever
sections.content: Chilly in the evening. Fever at night. Sour, greasy perspiration.

sections.title: Skin

intro: The great anti-spasmodic remedy. Cramping of muscles with radiating pains. Neuralgic pains relieved by warmth. Especially suited to tired, languid, exhausted subjects. Indisposition for mental exertion. Goitre. ’ Mind — Laments all the time about pain. Inability to think clearly. Sleepless on account of indigestion.

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Vertigo on moving, falls forward on closing the eyes, better walking in open air. Aches after mental labour, with chilliness; always better by warmth (Sil.). Sensation as if the contents of the skull were liquid, as if the parts of brain were changing places or as of a cap was on the head.

sections.title: Eyes
sections.content: Supraorbital pains; worse, right side; relieved by warmth applied extemally. Increased lachrymation. Twitching of lids. Nystag- mus, strabismus, ptosis. Eyes hot, tired, vision blurred, coloured lights before eyes. M 408 Magnesia phosphorica

sections.title: Ears
sections.content: Severe neuralgic pain; worse behind the right ear; worse, by going into cold air, and washing face and neck with cold water.

sections.title: Mouth
sections.content: Toothache; better by heat and hot liquids. Ulceration of teeth (caries), with swelling of the glands on the face, throat and neck, and swelling of tongue (glossitis). Complaints in teething children. Spasms without febrile symptoms.

sections.title: Throat
sections.content: Soreness and stiffness, especially on the right side; parts seem puffy, with chilliness, and aching all over.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Hiccough, with retching day and night. Thirst for very cold drinks.

sections.title: Abdomen
sections.content: Enteralgia, relieved by pressure. sections.title: Female
sections.content: Menstrual colic. Membranous dysmenorrhea.         Menses too early, dark, stringy. Swelling of external parts. Ovarian neuralgia. Vaginismus.

sections.title: Heart

Ears — Severe neuralgic pain; worse behind the right ear; worse, by going into cold air, and washing face and neck with cold water.

Stomach — Hiccough, with retching day and night. Thirst for very cold drinks.
Abdomen — Enteralgia, relieved by pressure. Flatulent colic, forcing the patient to bend double; relieved by rubbing, warmth, pressure; accompanied with belching of gas, which gives no relief. Fever — Chilliness after dinner, in the evening. Chills run up and down the back, with shivering, followed by a suffocating sensation.

intro:
(Magnolia) Magn-gr.

Rheumatism and cardiac lesions are prominent features in the symptomatology of this drug. Stiffness and soreness. Altemating pains between spleen and heart. Patient is tired and stiff. Soreness when quiet. Erratic, shifting of pains. Heart — Oppression of the chest with an inability to expand the lungs. Sensation of a large bolus of food which distresses the stomach. Sensation of suffocation when walking fast or when lying on the left side. Dyspnea. Crampy pains in the heart. Angina pectoris. Endocarditis and pericarditis. Tendency to faint. Sensation as if the heart had stopped beating. Pain around the heart accompanied by itching in the feet. Extremities — Stiffness and sharp erratic pains; worse in joints. Feet itch. Numbness in the left arm. Rheumatic pain in clavicles. Shooting in all limbs. Modalities — Worse, damp air, lying on the left side; in the moming, Malandrinum e Mancinella 411M

on first rising. Better, dry weather, motion; intermenstrual flow (Ham.; Bov.; Bell.; Elaps.).

intro:
(Manganese Acetate) Mang-act.

Mang-act. causes anaemia with destruction of the red corpuscles. Jaundice, nephritis with albuminuria. Fatty degeneration of the liver. Paralysis agitans. Cellulitis, subacute stage, promotes suppuration and hastens regeneration. Symptoms of chronic poisoning, according to Professor von Jaksch, were involuntary laughter, involuntary weeping and walking backwards. Strongly exaggerated reflexes and physical disturbances, evidenced by men making fun of each other's gait. Paraplegia progressive; wasting, feeble and staggering gait. Inflammation of bones (osteomyelitis) or joints (arthritis), with noctumal digging pains. Asthmatic people who cannot lie on a feather pillow. name: Medorrhinum
author: Boericke
intro: A powerful and deep acting medicine, often indicated for chronic ailments due to suppressed gonorrhea. For women with chronic pelvic disorders. Chronic rheumatism. Great disturbance and imitability of nervous system. Pain intolerable, tensive; nerves quiver and tingle. Children dwarfed and stunted. Chronic catarrhal conditions in children. Nose dirty, tonsils enlarged, thick yellow mucus from the nostnils; lips thickened due to breathing from the mouth. State of collapse and trembling all over. History of sycosis. Often restores a gonortheal discharge. Intensity of all sensations. Oedema of limbs; dropsy of serous sacs. Disseminated sclerosis.

sections.title: Mind
sections.content: Weak memory. Looses the thread of conversation. Cannot speak without weeping. Time passes too slowly (Cann-i.; Arg-n.). Is in a great hurry. Hopeless of recovery. sections.title: Abdomen

sections.title: Rectum

sections.title: Urinary

sections.title: Male

sections.title: Female

intro: (Cyanide of Mercury) Merc-cy. Acute infections, pneumonia, nepliritis. Its action is similar to that of the toxins of infectious diseases. Great and rapid prostration, tendency towards haemorrhages, from different orifices, of dark fluid blood, cyanosis, rapid respiration and heart action, albuminuria, twitching and jerking of muscles. Typhoidal pneumonia. Livid states from great struggling, where suffocation is imminent and paralysis of, lung threatening; profuse sweat. Affects the buccal cavity most prominently. Syphilitic ulcers when perforation threatens.

intro: A remedy for neuralgia, neurasthenia, malaria; typhoid, here it diminishes the tympanites, delirium and fever; pus infection. Tendency to tremor, chorea and epilepsy. author: Boericke
modalities: Worse, cold air; night, evening until midnight, warm food, touch, motion. Better, open air.
relationships: Compare: Dirca palustris—Leather wood (a gastro- intestinal imitant inducing salivation, emesis and purgation; cerebral hyperemia, neuralgic pains, with depression, palpitation and dyspnea); Merc.; Phyt.; Rhus-t.; Guaj.; Syph. Antidotes: Kali-i.; Merc.
intro: Skin symptoms, affections of the bones and neuralgias most important, especially around the teeth and face. Bruised, weary feeling in joints, with drawing and stiffness. Pain of various kinds, with chilliness and sensitiveness to cold air. Bone pains. Emnuptions after vaccination. Buming, darting sensation in the muscles; subsultus tendinum. Pain shoots upward and seems to draw the patient out of bed. Semi-lateral complaints. Patient is very sensitive to cold air.

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Hard work to talk’.         Headache; worse from talking. Stupefying headache on the night side. Affections of the external head; scaly eruptions, white scabs. Head covered with thick, leathery crusts, under which pus collects (crusta lactea). Violent neuralgia around the face and teeth, extending to the ear, at night; worse, eating; better nearhot stove. Roots of teeth decay. Teeth feel elongated.

sections.title: Eyes
sections.content: Ciliary neuralgia after surgery especially after removal of eyeball. Pain radiates and shoots downward, with a cold feeling and stiffness of the bone.

sections.title: Ears
sections.content: Feel too open, as if the tympanum was exposed to cold air and it blew into’the ear. Desire to bore fingers in.

sections.title: Nose
sections.content: Sneezing, coryza; interior of nose, excoriated. Post nasal adenoids.

sections.title: Face
sections.content: Red. Eruptions around the mouth, with coryza.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Desire for ham-fat. Burning in the tongue, extending to the stomach. Mouth waters. Nausea felt in the throat; better, eating. Chronic gastritis; buming, corroding pain; nausea, vomiting, chocolate colour. Gastric ulcer with severe buming.

sections.title: Abdomen
sections.content: Swelling of glands with a large abdomen in children. Pressure in the inguinal ring (hemia). Flatulent colic with shivering and difficult respiration.

sections.title: Rectum
sections.content: Constipation after confinement. Prolapse of rectum. Diarrhea with small, white particles. Green discharges. Constipation, with hepatic and uterine inertia. Constriction of the anus; stitches and prolapse of rectum. * ' Aversion to talking, seems like hard work to even utter a word. (Clarke — Dictionary of Practical Materia Medica). M 432 Mezereum e Micromeria douglasii Urinary — Red flakes float on top of urine. Hot, bloody. Biting, buming in the forepart of the urethra at the close of micturating (urethritis). Haematuria preceded by crampy pain in the bladder. After micturating, a few drops of blood are passed. Male — Enlargement of testicles (orchitis). Violent sexual desire. Gonorrhea with haematuria. Female — Menses too frequent, soon, profuse (menorrhagia). Leucorrhea like albumen; very corroding. Respiratory — Soreness and buming in the bones of thorax. Constriction across the chest. Cough; worse, eating, imitation lower than can be reached, on taking a warm drink. Back and Extremities — Pain in the neck and back; worse, motion and at night; intolerant of all touch. Pain and buming in the tibia and long bones. Legs and feet go to sleep. Pain in hip and knee. Skin — Eczema; intolerable itching; chilliness with pruritus. Worse in bed. Ulcers itch and bum, surrounded by vesicles and shining, fiery red areola. Herpes zoster, with buming pain. Bones, especially long bones, inflamed and swollen; caries, exostosis; pain worse night, touch, damp weather (Merc.; Syph.). Eruptions ulcerate and form thick scabs under which purulent matter exudes (Chrys-ac.).

sections.title: Modalities
sections.content: Worse, cold air; night, evening until midnight, warm food, touch, motion. Better, open air.

Head — Dizzy, contents of the head feel lighter; mist before the eyes.
Abdomen — Rumbling, gripping, colicky pains, starting from the back, spreading over the entire abdomen.

name: Morphinum
author: Boericke
intro: Morphine bears the same relation to Opium as Atropine to Bella- donna i. e., represents its nervous side. It is less stimulating, less convulsant and more decidedly hypnotic. Constipates less and affects the contractility of the bladder more. It is less diaphoretic and more pruritic.

sections.title: Mind
sections.content: Profound depression. Iritable, fault finding, hysterical. Shock induced by terror. Dream like state.

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Vertigo from the least movement of the head. Headache, with a sensation of being “wound up.” Bursting pain; head drawn back (tetanus, convulsions}.

sections.title: Eyes
sections.content: Bluish, drooping lids. Itching in the eyes. Delusions of vision on closing the eyes. Staring, injected; diverging strabismus. Pupils unequally contracted. Look unsteady. Ptosis. Paresis of rectus interni.

sections.title: Ears
sections.content: Left ear throbs painfully; better, heat. Seems to hear the circulation all over the body.

sections.title: Nose
sections.content: Sneezing in paroxysms. Itching and tingling on the tip of the nose. Morphinum 435 M

sections.title: Face
sections.content: Dusky red or pallid lividity of the face, lips, tongue, mouth or throat.

sections.title: Mouth
sections.content: Very dry. Tongue dry, brown violet in the middle.         Thirst. Loss of appetite with an aversion to meat.

sections.title: Throat
sections.content: Dry and constricted. Pharynx paralyzed, swallowing is almost impossible; better hot drinks, worse solids.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Nausea incessant and deathly, faintness, constant retching. Vomiting of green fluid (bile). Nausea and vomiting on rising up.

sections.title: Abdomen
sections.content: Distended. Acute pain in the abdomen and along the spinal cord. Tympanites.

sections.title: Stool
sections.content: Diarrhea watery; brown, or black with horrible tenesmus. Constipation; stools large, dry, knotty, with a tendency to bruise and fissure.

sections.title: Urinary
sections.content: Paresis of the bladder. Strangury; slow and difficult micturition. Retention of urine from prostatic hypertrophy. Uremia, acute and chronic.

sections.title: Male
sections.content: Impotency. Pain in the right spermatic cord (Ox-ac.).

sections.title: Respiratory
sections.content: Faint and struggling for breath; diaphragmatic paralysis; hiccough; dyspnea, paroxysmal, on first falling asleep (Lach.; Grin.). Cheyne-Stokes respiration. Chest tight. Pain in the middle of the stemum. Dry, hard, teasing, exhausting cough, worse at night. Strangling cough with viscid mucoid sputum; thin, scanty, but sounds loose and abundant.

sections.title: Heart
sections.content: Alternation of tachycardia and bradycardia. Cardiac muscular tissue is intact, even if severely exhausted. Pulse small, weak, dicrotic.

sections.title: Back
sections.content: Pain along the spine. Weakness in the loins. Aching across the lumbosacral region; cannot walk erect (Cimic.).

sections.title: Extremities
sections.content: Staggering gait (locomotor ataxia). Numbness.

sections.title: Sleep
sections.content: Yawning, drowsy; prolonged, deep sleep. Sleepless; restless sleep, with frequent startings. Sleepy, but cannot sleep. Nervous System — Restlessness and hyperesthesia; trembling, twitching, jerking, convulsions. Extremely susceptible to pain. Pain causes twitching and jerking of limbs (chorea). Violent, sudden neuralgic pains and sudden fainting. Delirium, melancholic in character. Neuralgias intensely painful; left supraorbital; right intercostal, better from heat; M 436 Moschus multiple neuritis. Sore feeling all over. Bed feels too hard. Aggravation after sleep (Lach.). Neuralgia after zoster (Mez.).

sections.title: Fever
sections.content: Chills. Icy coldness. Buming heat; profuse sweat. Skin — Livid; purple spots; zoster like herpes. Itching. Skin looses its elasticity. Urticaria appearing at climaxis.

sections.title: Dose
sections.content: Third to sixth trituration.

name: Moschus
author: Boericke
modalities: Better, in the open air, rubbing.    Werse, cold. Open air feels very, very cold.
relationships: Compare: Nux-m.; Asaf.; Valer.; Sumb.; Ign.; Castm. Compatible: Ambr. Antidotes: Camph.; Coff.
intro: A remedy for hysteria and nervous paroxysms, fainting fits and convulsions, catalepsy, etc. The characteristic condition being aggrava- tion by cold; there is great sensitiveness to air. Marked nervous trembling and frequent fainting. Great flatulence. Diseases do not follow a normal course. Coldness. Tension in the muscles, skin and mind.

sections.title: Mind
sections.content: Uncontrollable laughter. Scolding. Anxiety with palpitations; starting as if frightened. Sexual hypochondnasis.

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Compressive pain over the root of nose. Pressure on top of the head. Vertigo on least motion; sensation as if falling from a great height. Scalp sensitive. Sounds in the ears as if from the retort of a cannon.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Desire for black coffee, stimulants. Aversion to food. Everything tastes flat. With stomach symptoms, anxiety in the chest. Distended. Faints when eating. Abdomen greatly distended. Spasmodic, nervous hiccough (Hydr-ac.; Sul-ac.; Ign.; Caj.).

sections.title: Urinary
sections.content: Profuse micturition. Diabetes. Male — Violent desire; involuntary emissions. Impotence, associ- ated with diabetes (Coca). Premature senility. Nausea and vomiting after coition. Female — Menses too early, too profuse (menorrhagia}, with a disposition to faint (Nux-m.; Verat.). Sexual desire, with intolerable titillation in parts (nymphomania). Drawing and pushing in the direction of the genitals; sensation as if menses would appear.

sections.title: Respiratory
sections.content: Tightness of the chest, is obliged to take a deeper breath. Sudden constriction of larynx (laryngismus) and trachea. Difficult respuation; chest oppressed; hysterical spasm of chest; asthma. Spasms of the glottis. Impending paralysis of lungs. Asthma with intense anxiety, Moschus @ Murex purpurea 437 M fear and smothering sensation. Cough ceases, mucus cannot be expec- torated. Globus hystericus.

sections.title: Heart
sections.content: Hyterical palpitations (angina pectoris). Trembling around the heart. Weak pulse and fainting.

sections.title: Modalities
sections.content: Better, in the open air, rubbing.    Werse, cold. Open air feels very, very cold.

sections.title: Relationship
sections.content: Compare: Nux-m.; Asaf.; Valer.; Sumb.; Ign.; Castm. Compatible: Ambr. Antidotes: Camph.; Coff.

sections.title: Dose
sections.content: First to third potency.

author: Boericke

relationships: Compare: Plat.; Lil-t.; Sep. (the latter lacks sexual erethism of Murx.). M 438 Muriaticum acidum
intro: Symptoms of the female sexual organs are most prominent, and have been clinically verified. Especially adapted to nervous, lively, affectionate women. Patient weak and run down.

sections.title: Mind
sections.content: Great sadness, anxiety and dread.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Sinking, all gone sensation in the stomach          (Sep.). Hungry, must eat.

sections.title: Urinary
sections.content: Urine frequent at night; smells like Valerian; constant urging (Kreos.).

sections.title: Female
sections.content: Conscious of the womb. Pulsations in the neck of the uterus. Sensation as if something was pressing on a sore spot in the pelvis; worse sitting. Pain from the right side of womb to the right or left breast. Sore pain in the uterus. Desire, easily excited, nymphomania. Least contact of parts causes violent sexual excitement. Menses irregular, profuse, frequent, large clots (menorrhagia, metrorrhagia). Sensation of protrusion. Prolapse; enlargement of the uterus (cancer of uterus), with pelvic tenesmus and sharp pains, extending towards the breasts: aggravated by lying down. Dysmenorthea and chronic endometnitis with displacement. Must keep legs tightly crossed. Leucorrhea green or bloody, alternates with mental symptoms and aching in the sacrum. Benign tumors of the breasts. Pain in the breasts during menstrual period.

sections.title: Modalities

name: Muriaticum Acidum
author: Boericke
modalities: Worse, in damp weather, before midnight. Better, lying on the left side.
relationships: Compare: Ph-ac.; Ars.; Bapt. Follows well after Bry. and Rhus-t. ; Antidote: Bry.
intro:
(Muriatic Acid) Mur-ac.

This acid has an elective affinity for the blood, producing a septic condition similar to that found in low fevers with high temperature and great prostration. Patient becomes so weak that she slides down the bed. Decomposition of fluids. Involuntary stools while passing urine. Haemorrhages. Mouth and anus chiefly affected. Mind — Irritable and peevish; fretful. Loud moaning. Great restless- ness. Sad, tacitum; suffers in silence. Head — Vertigo; worse lying on the right side; occiput heavy as if filled with lead. Sound of voice is intolerable. Pain as if the brain was crushed. Nose — Haemorrhage; intense sneezing. Face — Lower jaw falls; pimples and freckles; lips raw, dry, cracked. Mouth — Tongue, pale, swollen, dry, leathery, paralyzed. Deep ulcers on the tongue. Hard lumps on the tongue. Epithelioma; edges bluish-red (Carb-ac.). Aphthous mouth. Gums and glands swollen. Fetid breath. Sordes on teeth. Throat — Uvula swollen. Ulcers and false membrane (diphtheria). Oedematous, dark, raw. An attempt to swallow produces spasms and choking. Stomach — Cannot bear sight or thought of meat. At times, ravenous appetite and constant desire to drink. Achlorhydria and fermentation of food.

sections.title: Rectum
sections.content: Tendency to involuntary evacuations while micturating. Haemorrhoids, extremely sensitive to any touch; even a sheet of toilet paper is painful. Anal itching and prolapsus ani while micturating. Haemorrhoids during pregnancy; bluish, hot, with violent stitches.

sections.title: Urinary
sections.content: Cannot micturate without having bowel movement at the same time.

sections.title: Female
sections.content: Menses appear too soon. Leucorrhea. During menses, soreness in the anus. Ulcers on the genitals.

sections.title: Heart
sections.content: Pulse rapid, feeble and small. Intermits every third beat.

sections.title: Extremities
sections.content: Heavy, painful, and weak. Tottering gait.       Pain in tendo-Achilles. Muriaticum acidum e Mygale lasiodora 439M

sections.title: Fever
sections.content: Cold extremities. Heat without thirst. Typhoid type, stupid. Haemorrhages. Restlessness. Involuntary discharges. Bed sores. Pulse rapid and feeble. Excessive prostration.

sections.title: Skin
sections.content: Papular and vesicular eruptions with great itching (Rhus- t.). Carbuncles; foul smelling ulcers on the lower extremities. Scarlet fever, livid, with petechiae; scanty eruption. Eczema on the back of hands.

sections.title: Modalities
sections.content: Worse, in damp weather, before midnight. Better, lying on the left side.

sections.title: Relationship
sections.content: Compare: Ph-ac.; Ars.; Bapt. Follows well after Bry. and Rhus-t. ; Antidote: Bry.

sections.title: Dose
sections.content: First to third potency.

author: Boericke

name: Naja Tripudians
author: Boericke
modalities: Worse, from use of stimulants; better, from walking or riding in open air.
relationships: Compare: Serpent poisons generally. Bungarus fasciatus (Banded Krait). This venom produces a condition like acute polioencephalitis and myelitis, both symptomatically and histologically. Lach.; Crot-h.; Spig.; Spong.
intro: Naja produces a typical bulbar paralysis (L. J. Boyd). Causes no haemorrhage but only oedema, hence the victims of this reptile frequently bear very little sign of external injury, a small scratch or puncture being the only indication where the fangs have worked their havoc. The tissue lying beneath the wound is dark purple and a large quantity of viscid blood like fluid collects in the vicinity of the wound. An intense buming pain at the spot bitten is the first symptom. In man there follows an interval before fresh symptoms occur. The average is about an hour. Once developed, the symptoms follow a rapid course. A feeling of intoxication is produced, followed by a loss of power over the limbs. The patient is bereft of speech, swallowing, and looses control over the movement of lips. The saliva is ejected in large quantities, respiration gradually becomes slower and slower, and at length ceases. Conscious all the time. Is not a haemorrhagic or septic medicine like Lach. and Crot-h. Its action settles around the heart; valvular problems. Marked surging of blood upwards, marked dyspnea, inability to lie on the left side. Hypertrophy, and valvular lesions. Organs seem to be drawn together. Very susceptible to cold. With heart symptoms, pain in the forehead and temples. Diseases primarily depending upon the degeneration of motor cells. Control of sphincters lost.

sections.title: Mind
sections.content: Broods constantly over imaginary problems. Suicidal insanity (Aur.). Depressed. Aversion to talking. Blurred speech. Melan- choly. Dread of being left alone. Fear of rain.

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Pain in the left temple and left orbit, extending to the occiput with nausea and vomiting (migraine). Hay fever, with dry larynx. Suffocative spells after sleeping (Lach.).

sections.title: Eyes

sections.title: Ears
sections.content: Illusions of hearing; otalgia; chronic otorrhea, black dis- charges; smells like herring brine.

sections.title: Female
sections.content: Neuralgia in the left ovary; often serviceable in obscure pains of left groin, especially in post-operative cases; seems; to be drawn to the heart. Respiratory — Grasping at the throat, with sense of choking. Irritating, dry cough, dependent on cardiac lesions (Spong.; Laur.). Sticky mucus and saliva. Asthmatic constriction in the ates Asthma begin- ning with coryza. Naja tripudians e Naphthalinum 443 N

sections.title: Heart

Palpitations. Stitching pain in the region of heart. Damaged heart after infectious diseases. Marked symptoms of low tension (Elaps, Vip.}.

sections.title: Sleep
sections.content: Profound; like a log with stertorous breathing, a typical reptilian state.

sections.title: Modalities
sections.content: Worse, from use of stimulants; better, from walking or riding in open air.

sections.content: Sixth to thirtieth potency.

name: Naphthalinum
common: A Chemical Compound from Coal-tar; Tar Camphor
author: Boericke
intro: Coryza, hay fever, phthisis pulmonalis, also gonorrhea have been influenced favorably by this drug. Pyelonephritis. Imitation of the periphery of the urinary apparatus. Whooping cough.

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Lying as if stupefied by a narcotic. Restless. Face pale. Yellowish hue.

sections.title: Eyes
sections.content: Marked affinity for the eye. It produces detachment of the retina; papillo-retinal infiltration; deposits in patches on the retina; amblyopia and consecutive amaurosis; sparkling synchisis; soft cataract. Exudation in the retina, choroid and ciliary body. Cataract. Opacity of the cornea (leucoma).

sections.title: Urinary
sections.content: Irresistible desire. Meatus red, swollen and oedema of prepuce (balanitis). Black urine. Cutting pain down the penis. Pain in the bladder (cystitis). Terribly offensive odor of decomposing ammoniacal urine.

sections.title: Respiratory
sections.content: Sneezing; eyes inflamed; painful; head hot. Hay fever. Spasmodic asthma; better in open air. Soreness in the chest and stomach; must loosen the clothing. Dyspnea and sighing inspiration. N 444 Narcissus poeticius e Natrium arsenicosum Emphysema in the aged with asthma. Whooping cough, long and continued paroxysms of coughing, unable to take a breath. Acute laryngo- tracheitis. Bronchitis when the spasmodic element is associated with tenacious expectoration and oppression (Cartier.). Skin — Dermatitis; itching infiltration. Eruptions at comers of mouth and pigmentation around the nails. Relationship — Compare: Dros.; Cor-r.; Coc-c. Terpin-hydras. (whooping cough, hay asthma and bronchial affections. 1-2 grain doses). Non-Homoeopathic Uses — For worms, especially pinworms, one- gram dose. Extemally in skin diseases, five percent ointment.

sections.title: Dose
sections.content: Third trituration.

name: Narcissus Poeticius
author: Boericke
intro:
(Daffodil) Narc-po.

Symptoms of nausea followed by violent vomiting and diarrhea. Daffodil bulbs contain an alkaloid, the action of which, according to authorities, varies as to whether the alkaloid is extracted from the flowering bulb or from the bulb after flowering. In the former case the alkaloid produces dryness of the mouth, checks cutaneous secretions, dilates the pupil, quickens the pulse and slows and weakens the heart contractions. On the other hand, the alkaloid from the bulbs after flowering, produces copious salivation, increases cutaneous secretion, contracts the pupil of the eye, produces a slight relaxation of the pulse, and slight faintness and nausea—The Lancet. A remedy for cough and bronchitis. Continuous cough. Coryza; frontal headache. Convulsive stage of whooping cough.

sections.title: Skin
sections.content: Erythema of a papular,            vesicular   and pustular type, aggravation in wet weather.

sections.title: Dose
sections.content: First attenuation.

intro:
(Arseniate of Sodium) Nat-ar.

A remedy for nasal catarrh with headache, pain at the root of the nose, dry and painful eyes. Psoriasis (Ars.; Chry-ac.; Thyr.). Bronchitis in children over seven years. Facilitates the termination of cold and conserves strength and appetite (Cartier.). Natrium arsenicosum @ Natrium carbonicum 445.N

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Floating sensation on tuming the head quickly; aching in the frontal region and root of the nose, over the orbits. Headache; worse, pressure and tobacco smoke.

sections.title: Eyes
sections.content: Catarthal conjunctivitis and blepharitis marginalis. Eyes feel - weak, stiffness of the balls and tendency of the lids to close. Feel heavy and droop (ptosis). Lachrymation on exposure to wind. Agglutination in the moming. Dry, painful, buming; tire soon. Oedema in the orbital region. Supraorbital pain.

sections.title: Nose
sections.content: Watery discharge; drops into the throat. Feels obstructed; pain at the root. Dry crusts, on removal, leave mucous membrane raw.

sections.title: Post
sections.content: nasal dropping of thick, bland, yellowish mucus. Crusts in nose.

sections.title: Throat
sections.content: Dark, purplish, swollen, oedematous; red and glassy (diphtheria).

sections.title: Respiratory
sections.content: Racking cough with profuse greenish expectoration. Oppression of the chest and around the heart, also in the larynx. Miner's asthma. Lungs feel as though smoke had been inhaled.

sections.title: Extremities
sections.content: Aching in the arms; worse in the shoulder. Pain in anterior crural nerves. Joints stiff. Feels tired all over. Knee joints crack (arthritis).

sections.title: Relationship
sections.content: Compare: Ars.; Kali-c.; Apis.

sections.title: Dose
sections.content: Third to thirtieth potency.

sections.title: Abdomen

sections.title: Rectum

sections.title: Urinary
sections.content: Pain just after micturating (Sars.). Increased, involuntary when walking, coughing, etc. Has to wait for a long time for it to pass if others are present (Hep.; Mur-ac.).

sections.title: Male
sections.content: Emission, even after coitus. Impotence with retarded emission.

sections.title: Female

sections.title: Respiratory

sections.title: Heart

sections.title: Extremities

sections.title: Sleep
sections.content: Sleepy in the forenoon. Nervous jerking during sleep. Dreams of robbers. Sleepless from grief.
