name: Electricitas
common: Electricity, effects of atmospheric and static electricity
author: Boericke
relationships: Compare: X-ray, Psor., Tub., Phos. Antidoted by: Morph-act. Antidotes: Merc.

sections.title: Source
sections.content: Attenuations are made from sugar of milk saturated with the current.

sections.title: Clinical
sections.content: Chorea; hysteria; paralysis; rheumatism; ottorrhea; asthma; convulsions; syncope; enuresis; haematuria. Presents a general picture of nerve and muscle relaxation; fainting, stiffness, paralysis, tremors, chorea, spasms, convulsions, ‘epilepsy, etc. General depression and weariness with giddiness or drowsiness, syncope with a tendency to fall down; decrease in body weight. Tingling sensa- tion in the electrified parts. Dreads the approach of a thunderstorm.

sections.title: Mind
sections.content: Intense nervous anxiety, screams with nervous fear; rest- less, uneasy. Timid, fearful, sighing and lachrymose; paroxysms of crying. Violent agitation. Dreads the approach of a thunderstorm; mentally tor- tured before and during a thunderstorm. Involuntary, hysterical, laughter; of ill humor; rage. Slow and difficult comprehension, insensible, loss memory. Looses consciousness and sensibility; stupefaction; looks around cold, with haggard eyes. Elec. should not be used when suffering from a especially if the chest is involved; fatal results have been observed.

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Giddiness, especially on stooping; dullness. Scurf on the occiput; scalp; promotes hair growth. Pain in the head; bruised pain in the H. M. M. — 40 1152 Electricitas tearing pain from the nape of the neck to the occiput. Violent pulsations or sensation of heat throughout the head. Tingling and prickling under the scalp.

sections.title: Eyes
sections.content: Inflammation of the eyes and profuse lachrymation, espe- cially of the right eye. Edges of eyelids and extemal angle swollen. Clouded vision, dim sighted. Blindness. Objects appear yellow and a dark room appears illuminated. Gnawing sensation in the left eye; or violent, drawing pain, extending to the forehead.

sections.title: Ears
sections.content: Ottorrhea with small pustules in the auditory duct. Aug- mented secretion of wax, whizzing in the ears; sensation as if obstructed by a plug. Swelling in the inner ear; pulsations in the ear with hyperemia and heat. Vesicles full of an acrid serum, behind the ears.

sections.title: Nose
sections.content: Anosmia; milky discharge from the nose. Tingling in the nose with sneezing.

sections.title: Face
sections.content: Expression of alarm or terror. Face red and swollen. Scabby eruptions on the face; lips are cracked; upper lip is swollen. Shocks throughout the body, proceeding from the malar bone.

sections.title: Mouth
sections.content: Tearing pain in upper teeth with headache. Pain from a subcutaneous ulceration in an old socket of molar teeth. Teeth grow rapidly in children. Increased secretion of saliva; foam in the mouth. Prominent papillae on the tongue; red and sensitive tongue, especially on the tip. Vesicles on the palate and tongue. Inability to articulate, results in loss of speech.

sections.title: Throat
sections.content: Imitation; pharyngitis; laryngitis.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Increased appetite; heartbum. Nausea, retching and vomiting; with profuse salivation; haematemesis. Sensation of fullness even after eating a small amount.

sections.title: Abdomen
sections.content: Spasmodic tension and contraction at the approach of a storm. Borborygmi with distention.

sections.title: Stool
sections.content: Diarrhea, hot yellowish-black, foetid, with drawing up of testicles during stool and tenesmus. Constriction of the anus after stool, buming in the anus. Haemorrhoids.

sections.title: Urinary
sections.content: Frequent micturition; enuresis; bloody urine with mucous or a white sediment. Sensation as if the bladder would burst.

sections.title: Female
sections.content: Catamenia. Profuse menses with pressure in the rectum. Leucorhea, first serous then thick with coagula, the size of a hazel nut.

sections.title: Respiration
sections.content: Short, irritable cough with tickling in the throat. Haemoptysis. Asthma with rapid respiration and tendency to syncope. Oppression of the chest. Electricitas e Enterococcinum 1153

sections.title: Heart
sections.content: Palpitations especially at the approach of a storm with a tendency to syncope. Lancinating pain spreads from the heart to the chest.

sections.title: Back
sections.content: Boils on the back and nape of neck. Difficulty in moving the neck; darting pain in the enlarged cervical glands. Tingling along the vertebral column.

sections.title: Extremities
sections.content: Severe pain in the arms and legs. Paralysis; sensation of numbness in the finger tips and feet, as if gone off to sleep. Trembling of hands and feet with a feeling of weariness. Hands red and swollen. Burning in feet upto the knees; tingling, knees down; and soles

sections.title: Sleep
sections.content: Yawning and shuddering all over the body; great drowsi- ness. Sleeplessness for two months. Confused dreams.

sections.title: Fever
sections.content: Shuddering all over, in the moming with yawning. At first shivering, then dry, transient heat with inflammation of the throat. Aug- mentation of internal heat; internal heat of parts which have sustained an electric shock; circulation of blood accelerated. Profuse perspiration, especially at night.

sections.title: Skin
sections.content: Blackish discolouration; ecchymosis. Itching or tingling all over the body. Miliary or measle like eruptions.

sections.title: Relationship
sections.content: Compare: X-ray, Psor., Tub., Phos. Antidoted by: Morph-act. Antidotes: Merc.

intro: Enteroc.

sections.title: Source
sections.content: It is prepared from a mixture of three stocks which are cultured for 24 hours at 37°C.

sections.title: Clinical
sections.content: Colitis; proctitis; dysentery; allergies. The digestive system is the primary seat of action for this drug. The tongue is white, like milk. Anorexia, nausea, eructations and flatulence is marked. Colitis and enterocolitis, which keeps relapsing due to an allergic condition. Haemorrhagic recto-colitis. Rectal tenesmus. Stools resemble,cow dung. Morning diarrhea with a great urgency, between 4-9 a.m. Dentitional, emotional and menstrual diarrhea with profuse mucus. Diarrhea accompanied by hypotension, slow pulse, fa- tigue, and imitability. 1154 Epihysterinum e Flavus

sections.title: Relationship
sections.content: Compare: Sulph., Podo., Crot-t., Dios., Cyn-d., Prot.

sections.title: Dose
sections.content: 4C to 9C.

sections.content: Coryza; sinusitis; conjunctivitis; loose teeth: dysmenor- thea; endometritis ; arthritis; sciatica; ecchymosis . Of marked value in eye, nose and throat affections. Left sided remedy. ‘Mind — Bad morals; exaggerates problems. Sensitive to emotions and contradictions; depressed.

sections.title: Eyes
sections.content: Right sided, periorbital headache (Sanq,). Asthenopia, marked in the evening . Eyes swollen in the moming; eyelids heavy; conjuctivitis. _Ears — Repeated attacks of otitis media. Right sided Otalgia .

sections.title: Nose
sections.content: Dry with crusts. Epistaxis in the moming; ozaena (Kali-bi). Sinusitis; frontal and maxillary sinuses tender; congestion of the nose at night ; one nostril stops and the other opens. Sneezing; better in the moming after sneezing.

sections.title: Face
sections.content: Flushes of heat at night.

sections.title: Mouth
sections.content: Loose teeth.

sections.title: Throat
sections.content: Dysphagia; globus hystericus; sensation of a feather in the throat (Kali-bi.) ; heaviness of the larynx after prolonged talking . Pain in the throat after getting feet wet. Inflammation of the throat; sensation as Flavus e Influenzinum 1155 if the palate is touching the tongue; dryness, worse at night. Frequent loss of voice.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Poor digestion ; frequent nausea after meals; aggravated by wine (Zinc.; Nux-v.).

sections.title: Female
sections.content: Irregular menses; dymenorrhea; menorthagia ; early with profuse, pale blood. Bleeding during ovulation. Delayed menses with pre- menstrual syndrome. Endometrosis.

sections.title: Respiratory
sections.content: Takes cold easily. Cough wakes him up between 1- 1.30 a.m. Dyspnea, worse towards 2 a.m. ; wakes up suffocated. Dry cough, worse in the moming.

sections.title: Back
sections.content: Arthrosis of the vertebral column; cracking. Cervico-brachial neuralgia.

sections.title: Extremities
sections.content: Left sided sciatica; pain in the left arm. Mild tremors, localized to the fingers.

sections.title: Skin
sections.content: Frequent ecchymosis; sweaty palms.

sections.title: Modalities
sections.content: Worse, cold, heat, in the moming on waking up. Better, after a hot bath, in the spring and autumn.

sections.title: Relationship
sections.content: Compare: Kali-bi., Zinc., Luff-a.

name: Lac Felinum
author: Boericke
relationships: Compare: Lac-c., Lac-d., Staph., Puls., Hep., Spig.

sections.title: Source
sections.content: A dilution of cat’s milk.

sections.title: Clinical
sections.content: Ciliary neuralgia; dysmenorrhea; styes; keratitis; leu- coma. Head and eye symptoms are most marked. The right half of the body, from head to foot feels extremely weak, heavy and distressed, as a result, it is difficult to walk. Constant nervous trembling, especially of hands.

sections.title: Mind
sections.content: Severe depression. Fear of falling down, without vertigo. Extremely conscientious, every little fault seems like a crime. Illusions that the comers of furniture or any pointed object will run into her eyes. Very cross at everyone.

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Dull pain and heaviness in the forehead and region of eyebrows. Pulsations in the head . Intense pain early in the moming, in the vertex and left side of head, involving the left half of nose and jaws; extends to the left ear. Pain never crosses the median line. Patient must close her eyes tightly due to the intensity or she holds her head firmly with her hands and rushes from one room to another, screaming; the severity of pain along the jaw causes the mouth to fill up with saliva. Lac felinum e Lac vaccinum Tlaieyr/

sections.title: Eyes
sections.content: Sharp lancinating pain through the center of left eyeball leaving it sore internally, resulting in profuse lachrymation. Eyes feel sunken. Similar pain in the center of night eyeball extending externally to the temple and frontal region over the eyes, with intense photophobia, redness of the conjunctiva and lachrymation, worse reading or writing. Pain appears to be in the interior of the eyeball; choroiditis. Muscular aesthenopia of the eye. Severe photophobia to natural and artificial light; eyes ache in gaslight. Styes; keratitis. Comeal ulceration. Eyes get bad every September.

sections.title: Nose
sections.content: Smell of clams (which she is fond of) is unbearable, making them unedible also.

sections.title: Mouth
sections.content: Hyperemia of the buccal cavity; apthae on the tongue and palate, stomatitis. Parts of mouth seem to stick together. Loss of taste.

sections.title: Throat
sections.content: Stringy, tough mucus in the pharynx, cannot hawk it up, must swallow. Yellowish expectoration, if and when expectorated. Poste- rior pharyngeal wall slightly inflamed.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Anorexia; desire to eat paper. Soreness and sensitive- ness in the epigastrium.

sections.title: Abdomen
sections.content: Distention after eating, must loosen clothing. Colic.

sections.title: Stool
sections.content: Normal stool at 2 a.m. On ceasing to strain, stool slips back, as if the rectum is unable to expel its contents.

sections.title: Urinary
sections.content: Frequent desire, urine very pale.

sections.title: Female
sections.content: Dysmenorrhea. Leucorrhea_ ceases on third, and reap- pears on the fourth day; yellowish discharge. Intense prunitis vulva. Dragging sensation down the pelvis, as if the uterus would come out.

sections.title: Respiratory
sections.content: Oppressed breathing, difficulty in taking a deep breath.

sections.title: Sleep
sections.content: Heavy, profound sleep, cannot be awakened easily. Dreams of earthquakes.

sections.title: Relationship
sections.content: Compare: Lac-c., Lac-d., Staph., Puls., Hep., Spig.

intro: (The magnet) M-ambo.

sections.title: Source
sections.content: The potencies are prepared by triturating sugar of milk which has been saturated when exposed to the emanations of a magnet.

sections.title: Clinical
sections.content: Syncope; haemorrhage; orchitis; paraphimosis; prolapsus ani; rheumatism; ulcers. Bruised pain in the joints where the cartilages of two bones touch each other, in the moming or on the side lain on. Joints are painful when touched; dull, numb pain; paralytic pain in all joints. Intolerable burning from head to feet. Sensation as if every part was cut up. Shuddering movement throughout the body. Spasmodic jerking and rising of the body from a recumbant position during shock or fright followed by loss of consciousness and then sensation of great heat. Fits of fainting with palpitations and suffocation; insensibility or deadly sopor.

sections.title: Mind
sections.content: Talks aloud, to himself while working, without being aware of it; says and does something different; tnes to do something but ends up doing something contrary; omits letters, words, syllables. Inclined to be angry, vehement. Absent minded.

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Vertigo, especially in the evening on lying down, staggers while walking. Headache follows least chagrin or from over strained memory. Pain as is bruised; digging, stupefying headache, as if a nail was driven into the head. Sensation on top of the head, as if the head and body were pressed down.

sections.title: Eyes
sections.content: Dilated pupils when cheerful; contraction during spasmodic attacks or syncope. Fiery sparks before the eyes, like shooting stars at twilight. Itching in the eyes, especially lids and inner canthi; sensation as if lids were dry.

sections.title: Ears
sections.content: Hardness of hearing. Humming in the ears with headache on the same side. Itching and buming in the auditory meatus.

sections.title: Nose
sections.content: Illusions of smell; a smoky or mouldy smell like manure.

sections.title: Face
sections.content: Sweat without heat, early in the moming. Violent, buming, lancinating pain in the facial muscles.

sections.title: Mouth
sections.content: Toothache after taking anything cold or from cold air; teeth loose. Shocks in the jaw and teeth with buming. Inflammation of submaxillary glands; profuse salivation especially in the evening with swollen lips. Halitosis which he himself does not perceive.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Hungry in the evening; has an appetite but no taste. Magnetis poli ambo 1161 Metallic taste. Aversion to tobacco although he relishes it. Eructations; tasting of ingesta which is spoiled or smells like saw dust. Acrid risings on stooping. Sensation of pressure on the stomach with cramps towards the upper part. Distention in the diaphragmatic region. Speedy satiety.

sections.title: Abdomen
sections.content: Borborygmi; noisy, rumbling; flatulent colic. Qualmish, painful sensation in the intestine with emission of hot, putrid flatus; especially during mental! exertion. Burning pain in the abdomen; itching around the umbilicus.

sections.title: Stool
sections.content: Constipation, as if the rectum was constricted and con- tracted, with headache lasting for several day. Haemorthoids, with severe pain after stools and buming in the anus when sitting; itchy; blind with soft stool. Prolapsus recti on straining for stool.

sections.title: Urinary
sections.content: Cystitis with buming in the neck of the bladder, a few minutes after micturating.

sections.title: Male
sections.content: Want of sexual desire; aversion to coition; penis relaxed, despite sexual excitement.. Erection without amorous thoughts, early in the moming. Nocturnal emission. Burning sensation in the region of spermatic vesicles, which excites sexual desire. Prepuce retreats entirely behind the glans. Epididymitis.

sections.title: Female
sections.content: Metrorrhagia in old women. Menses which had ceased a few days before, retum a day after imposing a magnetic surface.

sections.title: Respiratory
sections.content: Convulsive cough at night; short attacks which do not wake him, with haemoptysis; shocks in the chest, anxious breathing and oppression of the chest. Mucus in the trachea is easily hawked up in the moming and evening. Asthma after midnight due to mucus in the chest, better coughing.

sections.title: Back
sections.content: Pain in the lumbosacral joint, in the moming when lying on a side and when stooping for a long time. Shocks or jerks in the lumbo- sacral region, almost arresting breathing. Twitching in muscles of the back, sensation as if something alive in them.

sections.title: Extremities
sections.content: Drawing pain in joints and muscles of arms; tearing, jerking pain after some exposure to cold. Cramps in the calves and toes on waking up in the moming. Heels bum; coms.

sections.title: Sleep
sections.content: Disturbed; talks, snores and, keeps tossing about. Wakes up at 3 a.m. Sleeps on the back early in the moming, with one hand under the occiput and the other on the abdomen, knees are slightly apart, half opened mouth with muttering and snoring; amorous dreams of emissions, without any actual emission. Lascivious dreams, even during a siesta with 1162 Magnetis polus arcticus prostratic discharge. Vivid dreams; dreams of boasting, bragging and feasting. Body jerks several times before going to sleep.

sections.title: Fever
sections.content: Shuddering all over the body with profuse sweat. Fever after midnight has no shuddering but a sensation of heat all over. Heat without thirst at night, with a desire to be uncovered.

sections.title: Skin
sections.content: Old wounds bleed afresh. Boils on various parts of the body. Continuous itching and pricking here and there followed by buming.

sections.title: Relationship
sections.content: Compare: M-arct., M-aust., Zinc., Anac., Podo., Caust., Ign., Bell., Lyc., Nux-v. Antidoted by: Ign., Zinc., Elec. Action lasts for 10 to 14 days.

Makes mistakes while writing; talks aloud to himself while attending to business. Calm, com- posed mood, devoid of care. Weak memory; sensation of intoxication.

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Vertigo with staggering; as if she would fall in any direction. Sensation as if the head was being pressed down by a load. sections.title: Eyes
sections.content: Exophthalmos; starring look. Intense itching inthe inner canthi and margin of lids, dryness of the eyelids with a prickling sensa- tion and profuse lachrymation early in the moming. sections.title: Ears
sections.content: Whizzing in ears with internal heat, as if from boiling water. Deafness, as if caused by a band over the ears.

sections.title: Nose

sections.title: Face

Itching in the forepart of the tongue, obliging one to rub and scratch.

sections.title: Abdomen
sections.content: Incarcerated flatus with gurgling and a withering sensation. Marked pressure in the abdomen from within outwaxd due to flatus, which wakes the patient up at night. sections.title: Urinary

sections.title: Female
sections.content: Feeble or suppressed menses.

sections.title: Heart

sections.title: Back

Sensation of great lassitude in legs, as if they would break when walking. Tearing pain with pressure on the outer side of the knee, extending down to the ankle. Buming, pulsative stitches in the calves; rigid tension in hamstrings, feel too short. Coms.

However when fully awake, cannot remember those ideas or thoughts clearly. Restless sleep, tosses about as the bed feels too warm.

sections.title: Fever

Caries; toothache, especially in carious teeth, as if the tooth would be tom out; pain extends upwards, towards the eye; gums inflamed with buming in the cheeks; pain worse after a meal, in a smoky room; better walking in open air. Toothache with jerks through the periosteum of the jaw. Accumulation of a lot of saliva in the mouth at night; pillow becomes wet because of it. Itching in the forepart of the tongue, obliging one to rub and scratch.
Stomach — Voracious appetite at supper, eats well, but develops a flat taste in the mouth immediately after, with a sensation of heat in the ear lobules. Tobacco disagrees. Long continuous, rancid heartburn. Fre- quent eructations of mere air with painful jerks. Sensation of weight in the stomach. Sudden gripping and throbbing in the pit of the stomach.
Abdomen — Incarcerated flatus with gurgling and a withering sensation. Marked pressure in the abdomen from within outwaxd due to flatus, which wakes the patient up at night. Sensation as if the abdomen would burst; flatulent colic. Continuous aching and pinching in the entire hypogastric region. Inguinal hernia; threatens to protrude especially when coughing. :
Stool — Obstinate constipation; large, hard, difficult to evacuate, often preceded by drawing, dysenteric pain in the hypog::strium. Blood with stools twice a uayak 1164 Magnetis polus arcticus
Urinary — Dark urine; copious emission.
Male — Nocturnal, involuntary emissions.      Excessive desire.
Female — Feeble or suppressed menses.
Respiratory — Suffocative, spasmodic cough around midnight, hin- dering sleep. Dry, asthmatic cough, worse walking in open air. Unceasing irritation which induces cough, this imitation can only be removed by suppressing the cough by will power.
Heart — Sudden oppression and sharp stitches on the left side of chest. Anxiety and qualmishness.
Back — Crackling in the cervical vertebra, especially the atlas, during motion. Backache, feels as if broken.
Extremities — Sensation of cramps along the arm with prickling as if it had gone off to sleep. Soreness of the right shoulder..Pain and stiffness in the finger joints, especially of the right side. Fracture like pain in the hip joints and lower limbs. Sensation of great lassitude in legs, as if they would break when walking. Tearing pain with pressure on the outer side of the knee, extending down to the ankle. Buming, pulsative stitches in the calves; rigid tension in hamstrings, feel too short. Coms.
Sleep — Spasmodic yawning with pain in the articulation of left jaw; feels dislocated. Constantly drowsy during the day. Lascivious dreams; vivid dreams. Sleeps well at night, generally on his back. Sings while sleeping, which usually wakes him up. Half awake at 2 a.m., filled with great ideas, in a state of perfect inner consciousness. Fever — Sensation of coldness, chills. Sensation of heat all over the body with cool hands and feet; cool perspiration on palms and soles.
Skin — Formication; tingling with a crawling itch, as of a fly or flea, followed by soreness.
Modalities — All symptoms are better by uncovering.

sections.title: Clinical
sections.content: Frostbite; hernia; ingrowing toe nails; menorrhagia; vari- cosis; enuresis; balanitis; orchitis. Laziness and heaviness of the body, with a feeling on anxiety; as if threatened with paralysis, as if he would fall. Bruised pain all over, as if he had been lying on stones. Stiffness and cracking in joints during motion. Legs feel bruised while walking in open air, becomes faint or is suddenly attacked by an inclination to sleep. Body feels light.

sections.title: Mind
sections.content: Morose, despondent, has an aversion to conversation and cheerful faces. Dislikes society. Passion and rage. Instability of ideas.

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Vertigo; as if intoxicated, staggers. Rush of blood to the head, without heat in the moming, in bed. Formication in the brain. Pressure and headache in the occiput. Jerks in the head.

sections.title: Eyes
sections.content: Dryness and smarting of eyelids, noticeable when moving them in the moming and evening. Lachrymation; amblyopia; diplopia. Swelling of the Meibomian glands of the lower lid, as if a stye would form, but it merely passes away.

sections.title: Ears
sections.content: Roaring; sensation of air; whizzing in the ears in the morning. Tearing pain in the cartilage of the outer and inner ear. Inflam- mation of the outer ear with rhagades.

sections.title: Mouth
sections.content: Inflammation of the submaxillary glands; profuse saliva- tion. Swollen tongue impedes speech. Jerks in the upper jaw.

sections.title: Throat
sections.content: Buming in the pharynx; sensation of strangulation.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Indifferent to eating or drinking; relishes food but has no desire for it; indifference to milk, bordering on an aversion. Food appears incipid. Nausea when stooping forward; inclination to vomit. Pain in the pit of the stomach.

sections.title: Abdomen
sections.content: Noisy borborygmi, flatulent colic, worse at night and early in the moming; portions of flatus spring up from here and there, which is painful. Pinching in the abdomen, brought on by a draft of air. Distended abdomen. with emission of a large quantity of air. Sensation as if the hemia would protrude.

sections.title: Stool
sections.content: Soft, loose stools preceded by gripping. Frequent and sudden desire, but expelled with difficulty. Constriction and contraction of 1166 Magnetis polus australis the rectum, preventing even flatus from passing. Itching haemorthoids.

sections.title: Urinary
sections.content: Enuresis due to relaxation of sphincter vesicae. Urethritis.

sections.title: Male
sections.content: Impotence, sudden cessation of all enjoyment at climaxis. Pain in the penis, as if some fibres were tom. Balanitis, orchitis: painful retraction of testies at night with drawing of spermatic cord. Emissions in a hemiplegia patient; paralysis worse after emission.

sections.title: Female
sections.content: Menorthagia, prolonged flow only during motion, ceases at rest. Discharge of blood accompanied with pain in the abdomen.

sections.title: Respiratory
sections.content: Cough and coryza with expectoration of a greenish mucus and dyspnea. Nocturnal paroxysm of fetid cough. Oppression of chest. Sighing respiration with involuntary deglutition.

sections.title: Heart
sections.content: Violent palpitations.

sections.title: Back
sections.content: Gnawing and smarting; pain as if sprained. Sensation of heat, commensing in the cervical vertebral and extending down the back.

sections.title: Extremities
sections.content: Sensation as if small snakes crawling down the left arm. Painful jerks in the arms from above downwards. Tingling, like little shocks along the arm. Cracking in the knee joints during motion: arthritis: tearing pain in the patella while walking. Jerks in the hamstring with contraction of the leg. Throbbing in the leg muscles after walking. Easy dislocation of a foot joint on making a false step. Varices; legs pain when left hanging down. Ingrown toe nails. Shoe bite on top and on the sides of the toes when walking.

sections.title: Sleep
sections.content: Dreams of fire, quarrels and fights. Sleepless and awake before midnight; desire to sleep at day break. Restless, frequently tums sides.

sections.title: Fever
sections.content: Ache in long bones before an attack of fever or ague. Thirst at the commencement of chills. Chills in a room, especially after an evening nap, without thirst. Intemal coldness, is actually quite warm, but must lie down and cover himself; followed by profuse sweat and shud- dering over the perspiring parts.

sections.title: Skin
sections.content: Corrosive itching in the evening, in bed.

sections.title: Modalities
sections.content: Worse, walking in cpen air, sitting, and hanging limbs down.

intro: Malar. '

sections.title: Source
sections.content: Is prepared from decayed vegetable matter, taken froma              ~ marsh, during the dry season, when the malarial parasite is most active. This vegetable matter is then placed in a glass jar filled with water and allowed to decompose for 12 weeks.

sections.title: Clinical
sections.content: Anaemia; neuritis; sciatica; bronchitis; beginning of tu- berculosis; enterocolitis; liver affections; splenic affections; cholecystitis; ague. ; Great exhaustion even after a short walk; as though had suffered from a long illness with anorexia; strong desire to lie down. Typhoidal, semi-paralytic state. Rheumatism; rheumatic paralysis and emaciation.

sections.title: Mind
sections.content: Feels      stupid and sleepy, very forgetful.

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Sensation as if he would become dizzy; dizziness on rising from a recling position. Dull headache with drowsiness; sensation as if the head would burst; frequent attacks beginning in the forehead.

sections.title: Eyes
sections.content: Aching above the inner canthi of nght eye. Eyes feel heavy and sleepy. Asthenopia with bluming of vision.

sections.title: Ears
sections.content: Drawing pain in right external ear. --Nose — Congestive feeling at the root of the nose, as in severe colds. Epistaxis in the moming; occasionally stopped up.

sections.title: Face
sections.content: Right cheek and malar bone itchy; better by gently nibling or scratching. Face warm as if flushed, this sensation spreads allover the body. |

sections.title: Mouth
sections.content: Pain in left upper teeth. Saliva more than usual; must swallow frequently. Sensation as if a few specs of pepper were on the tip of the tongue. Tongue coated white; bitter taste.

sections.title: Stomach
sections.content: Continuous nausea; retching, vomiting of bile. Easy, bland belching. Odor or cooking is pleasing but does not have a desire to eat; on sitting down eats a good dinner with relish. Thirsty, craves cold drinks, especially lemonade.

sections.title: Abdomen
sections.content: Rumbling and buming in the abdomen; sense of heat. Sensation as if loose stools will come (but they do not come}; sensation as if the spleen would ache. Cannot breathe on account of pain in the liver; better hard pressure, worse lying down. Aching under nght scapula. Uneasiness in lower abdomen. Tired feeling in the abdomen and chest. 1168 Malaria officinalis e Meningococcinum

sections.title: Stool
sections.content: Diarrhea in the moming; bloody; yellow; foul smelling. Long standing haemorrhoids; bleeding but, no pain.

sections.title: Urinary
sections.content: Highly coloured urine like strong tea, strong ammoniacal smell; frequent, scanty micturition. Ineffectual desire.

sections.title: Respiratory
sections.content: Shallow breathing; frequent sighing. Malaria anti- dotes phthisis and a tubercular constitution is protected against malaria.

sections.title: Back
sections.content: Neck and back feels tired; stiffness and lameness; cervical spondylosis. Lumbago; pain radiates up the back, worse lying down, walking; better lying on the abdomen.

sections.title: Extremities
sections.content: Aching, tired feeling in the arms, hands and legs. Legs weary from a short walk. Legs restless, feels like stretching and moving them.

sections.title: Sleep
sections.content: Must lie down. Sense of dizziness on falling asleep, thus preventing sleep. Sleepy all the time; can go to sleep while standing. Sleep does not relieve drowsiness, wakes up unrefreshed. Constant yawning and a desire to stretch.

sections.title: Fever
sections.content: Chills all over, ascending from the legs. Face feels warm, as if flushed or feverish, spreads all over the body. Intermittent quotidian and tertiary fever. Ague, every altemate day; weak and drowsy between attacks. High fever at night and in the moming. Chills begin at noon; icy cold from hips down. Profuse perspiration.

sections.title: Modalities
sections.content: Worse least effort, in a closed room and lying down. Better, by rest, fresh air and hard pressure.

sections.title: Relationship
sections.content: Compare: Ars., Eup-per., Nat-m., Chin., Chinin-s., Ip., Puls., Acet-ac.

name: Toxoplasma Gondii
author: Boericke

intro: Toxo-g.

sections.title: Source
sections.content: The human toxoplasma has an essentially alimentary origin due to the ingestion of infected pork or meat. Toxoplasma gondii is diluted and dynamised according to the homoeopathic pharmacopea.

sections.title: Clinical
sections.content: Lymphadenitis; tuberculosis; infectious mononucleosis; encephalo-myelitis; chorea; epilepsy; multiple sclerosis; hepatitis; Wilson’s disease; Crohn’s disease; myocarditis; myositis; arthritis purpura. Toxoplasma gondii has polychrest indications but lacks a well proved pathogenesis. It has a slow and deep action on the tissues with genetic repercussion. Tuberculosis and pre-cancerous states with iso- lated and persistent, non-suppurating adenopathies of the periphery with asthenia. Bumt out condition. General toxoplasmosis in immuno sup- pressed cases. Children have mental and physical retardation with a tendency to repeated attacks of rhino-pharyngitis. Infectious mono- nucleosis in children with sub-febrile states; discrete adenopathy and eosinophilia. Neonatal septicemia with hepatitis, hepato-splenomegaly and purpura. Hodgkin’s disease; acute lymphocytosis.

sections.title: Mind
sections.content: Depression; mental retardation in children. Mongolism.

sections.title: Head
sections.content: Meningo-encephalitis; post infectious epileptiform convul- sions in babies, convulsions in children; hydrocephalus; chorea, multiple sclerosis.

sections.title: Eyes
sections.content: Iridocyclitis, chorio-retinitis and uveitis. Optic neuritis.

sections.title: Abdomen
sections.content: Hepatitis with hepatomegaly, Wilson's disease. Diffuse abdominal pain, not localised. Acute or sub-acute mesenteric lymphad- enitis; Crohn’s disease. Follicular inflammation of the ileum.

sections.title: Female
sections.content: Repeated abortions, especially during the first three months. Normal pregnancy with congenital toxoplasmosis. Menorthagia; metrorrhagia.

sections.title: Heart
sections.content: Praecordial pain, palpitations, dyspnea on any effort, ortho- pnea and cough. Noctumal polypneic attacks. Tachycardia with occa- sional arrhythmia; galloping sound with systolic murmer. Hyptension. E.C.G. shows changes in the ST segment and T wave; left ventricular hypertrophy, problems in conduction; fibrillation or auricular flutter due to bundle branch block, extra systoles; subacute myocarditis. Hereditory cardiomegaly. Congenital cardiopathies.

sections.title: Back
sections.content: Myelitis in children and adults.        Hemiplegia, paraplegia. Arthnitis and myositis. V.A.B. 1177

sections.title: Skin
sections.content: Maculo-papular or vesiculous exanthema; polymorphus erythema. Purpura.

name: Amanita Phalloides
author: Boericke
intro:
(in ‘relation’ to Agaricus muscarius) Agar-ph.

-Death Cup or Deadly Agaric- the poison is a toxalbumin, resembling the poison of rattle snake and the poison excreted by cholera and diphtheria germs. It acts on the red blood corpuscles, dissolving them, as a result, blood escapes into the alimentary canal and the whole system is drained. The amount of the toxic principle required is small, even handling the specimen or breathing the spores affects some people unpleasantly. The poison is slow in development. Even 12 to 20 hours after taking it the patient feels all right, however it is followed by vertigo, violent choleric symptoms, rapid loss of strength and death on the second or third day, preceded by stupor and spasms. Fatty degeneration of the liver, heart, and kidneys, haemorrhages in the lungs, pleura and skin (Dr. J. Schier). Vomiting and purging. Continuous urging to stool, but no gastric, abdominal or rectal pain. Intense thirst for cold water, dry skin. Lethargic but mentally clear. Sharp changes from rapid to slow and from slow to rapid breathing, extreme collapse, suppressed urine, but absence of cold extemities or cramps.

It disintoxicates in cancer (administered subcutaneously in the treatment of diseases of skin, kidney and intestines, gastro enteritis and tuberculosis). Scrofulous affections in children-lymphadenitis. Lupus, eczema, varicose ulcers. A great “blood purifier and vitalizer”. Potentized sea water is useful in weakness, lack of reaction; symptoms worse at seaside. Goitre. ; 1188 Rare and Uncommon Remedies

name: Caffeinum
author: Boericke
intro: A crystalline alkaloid — is a direct heart stimulant and diuretic. Dropsy depending on cardiac insufficiency. Myocardial degeneration Cardiac insufficiency in pneumonia and other infectious diseases. Raises the blood pressure, increases the pulse rate and stimulates the heart muscle; hence, a support in extreme feebleness or threatened failure. Stimulates the respiratory centre, nerve centres and increases diuresis. One of the best stimulants of the vaso-motor centres. Acute pulmonary edema. Brachialgia and other neuralgias characterized by noctumal exacerbations. Jousset uses equal parts of caffein and saclac. 3 grains taken in divided doses every other day. Hypodermically, 1.4 grain. Excruciating facial neuralgia from decayed teeth.

Diarrhea and cough; acute pain in the chest. Mesenteric tuberculosis. Bleeding from lungs; angina pectoris; asthma; affections of arteries. Veins stand out like whipcords. Attacks of pain occurring two hours after meals (relieved by a cup of milk or light food).

name: Formicum Acidum
author: Boericke
intro:
(in ‘relation’ to Formica rufa) Form-ac.

Chronic myalgia. Muscular pain and soreness. Gout and articular rheumatism, which appears suddenly. Pain usually worse on the right side, motion and better from pressure. Failing vision. Increases muscular strength and resistance to fatigue. Feels stronger and more ‘fit’. Tremor. Tuberculosis, chronic nephritis and carcinoma, lupus, etc. have been treated successfully with injections of Form-ac. in a dilution correspond- ing to the 3rd and 4th centesimal. In prescribing it for varicose veins, polypi, catarrh, Dr. J.H. Clarke orders an ounce or two of a solution of

sections.title: Form
sections.content: ac. in the proportion of one part of the acid to eleven of distilled water. Of this solution one teaspoonful is taken in a tablespoonful of water after meals once or twice daily. Pain in the aponeurosis and muscles of the head, neck and shoulders before a snowstorm. Rhus., Dulc., Urt. and Juniperus contain Form-ac. Wood alcohol, when taken as a constituent of a beverage, so common in these prohibition days is not eliminated easily and is slowly converted into Form-ac., which attacks the brain and causes death or blindness. Dr. Sylwestrowicz of Hering Research Laboratory in the Hahnemann College, Philadelphia contributes his experience with Form-ac. as follows: "The best field for Form-ac. treatment are cases of atypical gout. Under this classification disturbances in the muscles such as myositis, periostitic processes of the bones in form of doughy swelling changes in the fascias such as Dupyutren's contraction, skin problems such as chronic excema, psonasis and loss of hair, renal disturbances such as subacute and chronic nephritis must be mentioned . In these cases Form-ac. in 12x and 30x, hypodermically 1 cc. is indicated at intervals of 2-4 weeks. Eight to twelve days after the first injection an aggravation is often noticed. In acute rheumatic fever and acute gonorthric arthritis, Form-ac. 6x, every six days 1 cc., sometimes 12 x in sensitive patients often shows splendid results abolishing the pains and preventing recurrence. Chronic arthritis needs a special discussion. Clinical experiments of the Hering Research Laboratory in the Hahnemann Medical College of Philadelphia on a great number of cases of arthritis with Form-ac. showed that it preferably acts on the ligaments, capsula and bursa of the joints. Such kind of cases respond to treatment readily. Rare and Uncommon Remedies 1221 The prognosis depends, to a large extent upon the etiology of the case. The most satisfactory cases are chronic arthritis in connect ion with a gouty diathesis. Chronic arthritis following an attack of acute rheumat ic fever also shows remarkable results, although often pains of neuralgi c character persisting in certain spots are very stubbom. Finally chronic arthnitis of a traumatic nature can be cured by Form-ac. In the latter case

sections.title: Form
sections.content: ac. 6x showed quicker and better results than 12x or 30x which are indicated in the previous cases. In general, the disappearance of the stiffness in the joint is the first sign of improvement. Then the pain and swelling cease gradually in 1-6 months time. The prognosis of Form-ac. treatment is not so favourable in chronic arthnitis in which the deformans processes has already taken place on the articular surfaces: Such processes in the beginning, can be checked completely, advanced cases frequently show an improvement. But there is always a possibility that this improvement is only temporary. This is particularly to be expected in cases of the so called arthritis deformans in which even the inflammations of the ligaments and capsula are of a very progressive character."

sections.title: Dose
sections.content: Sixth to thirtieth attenuation.

Clinical experiments of the Hering Research Laboratory in the Hahnemann Medical College of Philadelphia on a great number of cases of arthritis with Form-ac. showed that it preferably acts on the ligaments, capsula and bursa of the joints. Such kind of cases respond to treatment readily. Rare and Uncommon Remedies 1221 The prognosis depends, to a large extent upon the etiology of the case. The most satisfactory cases are chronic arthritis in connect ion with a gouty diathesis. Chronic arthritis following an attack of acute rheumat ic fever also shows remarkable results, although often pains of neuralgi c character persisting in certain spots are very stubbom. Finally chronic arthnitis of a traumatic nature can be cured by Form-ac. In the latter case
Form — ac. 6x showed quicker and better results than 12x or 30x which are indicated in the previous cases. In general, the disappearance of the stiffness in the joint is the first sign of improvement. Then the pain and swelling cease gradually in 1-6 months time. The prognosis of Form-ac. treatment is not so favourable in chronic arthnitis in which the deformans processes has already taken place on the articular surfaces: Such processes in the beginning, can be checked completely, advanced cases frequently show an improvement. But there is always a possibility that this improvement is only temporary. This is particularly to be expected in cases of the so called arthritis deformans in which even the inflammations of the ligaments and capsula are of a very progressive character."
Dose — Sixth to thirtieth attenuation.

name: Natrium Taurocholicum
author: Boericke
intro:
(in ‘relation’ to Cholesterinum) Nat-taur.

— Taurocholate soda — Dr. IP. Tessier, in an interesting study of the action of bile and its salts in hepatic affections, analyzes a number of experiments by leading authorities, with the object of determining its action, and concludes that the Taurocholate of soda, homoeopathically is a useful remedy against certain forms of hypoglobular anaemia. It Serves us as a remedy in cases of hypertrophy of the spleen and ganglia. He calls our attention to the fact that it produces dyspnea, Cheyne — Stokes respiration, acute pulmonary oedéma, and intense exaggeration of the cardiac pulsations, offering a good field for clinical studies and experimentation of great interest which may give fruitful and important results.
